rules.rule_name: Program Initialization
rules.rule_description: At the start of every program execution, error indicators, screen erase flags, and message fields are reset to their default states to ensure a clean processing environment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1: Program Initialization
Initialize error flags, erase flags,
clear message fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail View program begins execution
acceptance_criteria.When: The program starts processing any user interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error flag is set to OFF, the screen erase flag is set to YES, the general message field is cleared to spaces, and the error message output field on the screen (ERRMSGO) is cleared to spaces

rules.rule_name: New Session Redirect to Authorization Summary
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Detail program is invoked for the first time with no prior session data, the system redirects the user to the Authorization Summary screen without displaying any detail.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2: New Session Redirect
Redirect to Authorization
Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail View program is invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: No communication area exists from a prior session (EIBCALEN = 0)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The communication area is initialized to empty values, the destination program is set to the Authorization Summary program (WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY), and control is transferred to the Authorization Summary screen via XCTL, passing the initialized communication area

rules.rule_name: First Entry Authorization Detail Load
rules.rule_description: On the first entry to the Authorization Detail screen (arriving from the Authorization Summary), the system automatically loads and displays the authorization details for the pre-selected authorization record without waiting for user input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3: First Entry Processing
Load and display authorization
detail record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid session exists (EIBCALEN > 0) and the program has not yet been re-entered (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is FALSE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user arrives at the Authorization Detail screen for the first time
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program marks the session as re-entered (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER = TRUE), performs the Enter key processing to read and populate authorization details, and sends the Authorization Detail screen to the user

rules.rule_name: Return to Authorization Summary via PF3
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system navigates back to the Authorization Summary screen, preserving the session context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5: Return to Authorization Summary
Navigate back to Auth
Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Authorization Detail screen and the session is in re-entry state
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The destination program is set to the Authorization Summary program (WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY), the current transaction ID is recorded as the originating transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), the current program is recorded as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL), the program context is set to zero, the entry flag is set to ENTER mode, and control is transferred to the Authorization Summary program via XCTL with the communication area

rules.rule_name: Mark or Unmark Authorization as Fraud via PF5
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF5, the system toggles the fraud status of the currently displayed authorization record — confirming fraud if not already flagged, or removing the fraud flag if already confirmed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6: Mark/Unmark Authorization as Fraud
Toggle fraud status of
current authorization

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Authorization Detail screen and the session is in re-entry state
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF5 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs the fraud mark/unmark process (MARK-AUTH-FRAUD) and then refreshes the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Navigate to Next Authorization via PF8
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8, the system advances to the next sequential authorization record for the same account and displays its details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7: Navigate to Next Authorization
Advance to next authorization
detail record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Authorization Detail screen and the session is in re-entry state
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF8 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs the PF8 navigation process (PROCESS-PF8-KEY) and then refreshes the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Invalid Key Message Display
rules.rule_description: When the user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF5, or PF8, the system displays an invalid key message and refreshes the screen without changing any data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8: Invalid Key Handling
Display invalid key message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen and the session is in re-entry state
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF5, or PF8
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs Enter key processing to reload the current authorization data, sets the message field to the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY), and sends the Authorization Detail screen back to the user

rules.rule_name: Authorization Record Retrieval Prerequisite Validation
rules.rule_description: Before reading an authorization record, the system validates that a valid account ID and a selected authorization key are present. If either is missing or invalid, an error is flagged and no database read is attempted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9: Authorization Record Retrieval
Read auth summary and detail
records from database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Enter key processing is triggered
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks the account ID and selected authorization
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is numeric AND the selected authorization key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED) is not spaces and not low-values, the system proceeds to read the authorization record from the database; otherwise, the error flag is set to ON and no database read is performed

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary and Detail Record Read
rules.rule_description: The system reads the authorization summary record from the PAUTSUM0 IMS segment and then reads the specific authorization detail record from the PAUTDTL1 IMS segment using the account ID and authorization key.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9: Authorization Record Retrieval
Read auth summary and detail
records from database

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid account ID and authorization key are available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the authorization records from the database
acceptance_criteria.Then: First, the Authorization Summary record (PAUTSUM0) is retrieved using the Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID); if found, the Authorization Detail record (PAUTDTL1) is retrieved using the Authorization Key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY / PAUT9CTS); if the summary or detail record is not found or the end of the database is reached, the end-of-records flag (AUTHS-EOF) is set to TRUE; if successfully read, the not-end-of-records flag (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) is set to TRUE

rules.rule_name: Next Authorization Detail Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: After reading the current authorization record, the system attempts to read the next sequential authorization detail record (PAUTDTL1) for the same account to support forward navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10: Next Authorization Record Retrieval
Read next sequential auth
detail record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current authorization record has been successfully read from PAUTDTL1
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to read the next sequential authorization detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next Authorization Detail record (PAUTDTL1) is retrieved sequentially; if a next record exists, the not-end-of-records flag (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) is set to TRUE; if no more records exist (segment not found or end of database), the end-of-records flag (AUTHS-EOF) is set to TRUE

rules.rule_name: End of Authorization Records Detection
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate forward past the last authorization record, the system informs the user they are already at the last record and retains the current screen content.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
11: End of Authorization Records Detection
Display 'Already at the last
Authorization' message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user pressed PF8 to navigate to the next authorization
acceptance_criteria.When: The end-of-records flag (AUTHS-EOF) is TRUE after attempting to read the next record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen erase flag is set to NO (current screen content is preserved without erasing), and the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' is displayed to the user

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Display Population
rules.rule_description: When no error condition exists, all authorization detail fields are populated on the screen from the retrieved authorization record data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
12: Authorization Detail Display Population
Populate screen fields with
authorization details

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been successfully retrieved
acceptance_criteria.When: The error flag is OFF (ERR-FLG-OFF is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following fields are populated on the screen: card number (PA-CARD-NUM to CARDNUMO), authorization date (formatted), authorization time (formatted), approved amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT to AUTHAMTO), response code interpretation, decline reason, processing code (PA-PROCESSING-CODE to AUTHCDO), POS entry mode (PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE to POSEMDO), message source (PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE to AUTHSRCO), merchant category code (PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE to MCCCDO), card expiry date (formatted), authorization type (PA-AUTH-TYPE to AUTHTYPO), transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID to TRNIDO), match status (PA-MATCH-STATUS to AUTHMTCO), fraud status, merchant name (PA-MERCHANT-NAME to MERNAMEO), merchant ID (PA-MERCHANT-ID to MERIDO), merchant city (PA-MERCHANT-CITY to MERCITYO), merchant state (PA-MERCHANT-STATE to MERSTO), and merchant zip (PA-MERCHANT-ZIP to MERZIPO)

rules.rule_name: Authorization Response Code Interpretation
rules.rule_description: The system interprets the authorization response code and displays the approval status with color coding — green for approved and red for declined.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
13: Authorization Response Code Interpretation
Determine Approved or Declined
with color coding

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the response code is '00', the status field (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'A' (Approved) and the field color (AUTHRSPC) is set to GREEN; if the response code is anything other than '00', the status field (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'D' (Declined) and the field color (AUTHRSPC) is set to RED

rules.rule_name: Decline Reason Code Lookup
rules.rule_description: The system looks up the authorization decline reason code in a predefined decline reason table and displays the corresponding description. If the reason code is not found, a default error indicator is displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
14: Decline Reason Code Lookup
Search decline reason table
for description

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the decline reason table (WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB) for a matching entry where DECL-CODE equals PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON
acceptance_criteria.Then: If a matching entry is found, the reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) is placed in positions 1-4 of AUTHRSNO, a '-' separator is placed in position 5, and the matching description (DECL-DESC) is placed starting at position 6; if no matching entry is found, '9999' is placed in positions 1-4 of AUTHRSNO, a '-' separator is placed in position 5, and 'ERROR' is placed starting at position 6

rules.rule_name: Fraud Status Display on Screen
rules.rule_description: The system displays the fraud status of the authorization, showing the fraud flag and report date if fraud has been confirmed or removed, or a dash if no fraud action has been taken.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
15: Fraud Status Display
Display fraud flag and
fraud report date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the fraud status of the authorization record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the authorization is marked as fraud confirmed (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED) OR has had fraud removed (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED), the fraud indicator field (AUTHFRDO) is populated with: the fraud flag (PA-AUTH-FRAUD) in position 1, a '-' separator in position 2, and the fraud report date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE) starting at position 3; if neither condition is true, the fraud indicator field (AUTHFRDO) is set to '-' only

rules.rule_name: Fraud Confirmation Toggle Logic
rules.rule_description: When the user requests a fraud status change (PF5), the system reads the current authorization record and toggles the fraud status — removing the fraud flag if already confirmed, or confirming fraud if not yet flagged.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
16: Fraud Confirmation Toggle
Check current fraud status
and toggle accordingly

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF5 to toggle the fraud status of the current authorization
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the current authorization record and evaluates its fraud status (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the authorization is currently marked as fraud confirmed (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is TRUE), the fraud flag is set to removed (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED = TRUE) and the action indicator is set to remove fraud (WS-REMOVE-FRAUD = TRUE); if the authorization is NOT currently marked as fraud confirmed, the fraud flag is set to confirmed (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED = TRUE) and the action indicator is set to report fraud (WS-REPORT-FRAUD = TRUE)

rules.rule_name: Fraud Processing Delegation to External Program
rules.rule_description: After toggling the fraud status, the system delegates the fraud processing to an external fraud management program, passing the full authorization details, account ID, and customer ID.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
17: Fraud Processing Delegation
Pass details to fraud
processing program COPAUS2C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud status has been toggled (confirmed or removed) for the current authorization
acceptance_criteria.When: The system calls the external fraud processing program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) via CICS LINK
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) is copied to the fraud data workspace (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD), the account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) is set in the fraud data area (WS-FRD-ACCT-ID), the customer ID (CDEMO-CUST-ID) is set in the fraud data area (WS-FRD-CUST-ID), and the fraud program is called with the complete fraud data communication area (WS-FRAUD-DATA)

rules.rule_name: Fraud Update Success Handling
rules.rule_description: When the external fraud program confirms a successful update, the system proceeds to save the updated authorization record to the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18: Fraud Update Success Handling
Update auth record and display
success message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program has been called
acceptance_criteria.When: The CICS LINK call returns a NORMAL response AND the fraud program reports a successful update (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs the authorization detail record update (UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS) to save the fraud status change to the database

rules.rule_name: Fraud Update Failure Handling
rules.rule_description: When the external fraud program reports a failure or the CICS call itself fails, the system rolls back all changes and displays an appropriate error message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19: Fraud Update Failure Handling
Rollback changes and display
error message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program has been called
acceptance_criteria.When: Either the CICS LINK call returns a non-NORMAL response, OR the CICS LINK call succeeds but the fraud program reports an unsuccessful update (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is FALSE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the fraud program returned an unsuccessful update, the fraud program's action message (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG) is moved to the display message field (WS-MESSAGE) and a rollback is performed; if the CICS LINK call itself failed, a rollback is performed without a specific fraud program message

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Record Update in Database
rules.rule_description: After a successful fraud status toggle confirmed by the external fraud program, the updated authorization detail record is saved back to the PAUTDTL1 IMS segment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
20: Authorization Detail Record Update
Save updated fraud status
back to database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud program has confirmed a successful fraud status update
acceptance_criteria.When: The system replaces the authorization detail record in the database (REPL on PAUTDTL1 segment)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the database update is successful, a transaction commit (syncpoint) is performed, and if the fraud was removed the message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' is displayed; if the fraud was confirmed the message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' is displayed; if the database update fails, a rollback is performed

rules.rule_name: Transaction Commit After Successful Fraud Update
rules.rule_description: After a successful authorization detail record update in the database, all changes are permanently committed to ensure data integrity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
21: Transaction Commit
Commit database changes

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization detail record has been successfully updated in the PAUTDTL1 database segment
acceptance_criteria.When: The database replace operation completes successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: A CICS SYNCPOINT is issued to permanently commit all database changes made during the current transaction

rules.rule_name: Transaction Rollback on Fraud Processing Failure
rules.rule_description: When any step in the fraud update process fails — either the external fraud program call, the fraud program's own processing, or the database update — all changes are rolled back to maintain data consistency.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
22: Transaction Rollback
Rollback database changes

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud status toggle operation is in progress
acceptance_criteria.When: Any of the following failure conditions occur: the CICS LINK call to the fraud program returns a non-NORMAL response, the fraud program reports an unsuccessful update, or the database replace operation fails
acceptance_criteria.Then: A CICS SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK is issued to undo all database changes made during the current transaction, ensuring no partial updates are committed

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Screen Display
rules.rule_description: After populating all screen fields, the system sends the Authorization Detail screen to the user's terminal, with or without erasing the previous screen content based on the erase flag.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24: Authorization Detail Screen Display
Send populated screen to
user terminal

acceptance_criteria.Given: All authorization detail fields and header information have been populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Detail screen (MAP COPAU1A, MAPSET COPAU01)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current message (WS-MESSAGE) is moved to the screen error message field (ERRMSGO), the cursor is positioned at the card number field (CARDNUML = -1); if the screen erase flag is YES (SEND-ERASE-YES), the screen is sent with ERASE to clear the previous terminal content; if the screen erase flag is NO (SEND-ERASE-NO), the screen is sent without erasing the previous terminal content

rules.rule_name: Screen Input Receipt
rules.rule_description: When the user is in a re-entry session, the system receives the user's input from the Authorization Detail screen before processing any keystrokes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
25: Screen Input Receipt
Receive user input from
authorization detail screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The session is in re-entry state (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes any user keystroke on the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system receives the screen input data from MAP COPAU1A (MAPSET COPAU01) into the input area (COPAU1AI) before evaluating which key was pressed

rules.rule_name: Authorization Date Formatting
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination date stored in YYMMDD format is reformatted to MM/DD/YY for display, and the authorization time is formatted with colon separators as HH:MM:SS.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
26: Date and Time Formatting
Format date YYMMDD to MM/DD/YY
and time with colons

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the authorization date and time for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) stored as YYMMDD is reformatted: positions 1-2 (YY) go to WS-CURDATE-YY, positions 3-4 (MM) go to WS-CURDATE-MM, positions 5-6 (DD) go to WS-CURDATE-DD, and the result is assembled as MM/DD/YY in WS-AUTH-DATE and moved to AUTHDTO; the authorization time (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) is formatted: positions 1-2 (HH) go to WS-AUTH-TIME positions 1-2, positions 3-4 (MM) go to WS-AUTH-TIME positions 4-5, positions 5-6 (SS) go to WS-AUTH-TIME positions 7-8, and the result is moved to AUTHTMO

rules.rule_name: Card Expiry Date Formatting
rules.rule_description: The card expiry date stored without a separator is formatted with a slash between the month and year for display purposes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
27: Card Expiry Date Formatting
Insert slash separator in
card expiry date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the card expiry date for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The first 2 characters of PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE (month) are moved to positions 1-2 of CRDEXPO, a '/' separator is placed in position 3 of CRDEXPO, and the last 2 characters of PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE (year) are moved to positions 4-5 of CRDEXPO, resulting in a MM/YY display format

rules.rule_name: Screen Header Population with Current Date and Time
rules.rule_description: Every time the Authorization Detail screen is displayed, the header is refreshed with the current system date and time, application titles, transaction name, and program name.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
23: Screen Header Population
Populate header with title,
transaction ID, date, time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen is about to be sent to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen header information
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current system date and time are retrieved, the application title lines (CCDA-TITLE01, CCDA-TITLE02) are moved to the screen title fields (TITLE01O, TITLE02O), the current CICS transaction ID (WS-CICS-TRANID) is moved to the transaction name field (TRNNAMEO), the program name (WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL) is moved to the program name field (PGMNAMEO), the current date is formatted as MM/DD/YY and moved to the current date field (CURDATEO), and the current time is formatted as HH:MM:SS and moved to the current time field (CURTIMEO)

key_functionalities.title: Program Initialization
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Program Start]) 
    B[Set Error Flag to OFF\nNo errors at startup]
    C[Set Screen Erase Flag to YES\nFull screen refresh enabled]
    D[Clear Working Storage\nMessage Field]
    E[Clear Screen Error\nMessage Display Field]
    F([Proceed to Next Step])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F

rules.rule_name: Initialize Error Flag to No-Error State at Program Startup
rules.rule_description: At the beginning of every program execution cycle, the error flag must be reset to its OFF (no-error) state to ensure no residual error condition from a prior interaction affects the current processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Error Flag to OFF
No errors at startup

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail View program has just been invoked and is beginning a new execution cycle
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initializes its working state before performing any business processing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Error Flag (ERR-FLG) must be set to OFF, indicating no error condition exists at the start of processing, so that subsequent business logic evaluates data freshly without any carry-over error state

rules.rule_name: Enable Full Screen Refresh at Program Startup
rules.rule_description: At the beginning of every program execution cycle, the screen erase flag must be set to YES so that the Authorization Detail screen is fully refreshed (erased and redrawn) when displayed, ensuring no stale data from a prior screen remains visible to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Screen Erase Flag to YES
Full screen refresh enabled

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail View program has just been invoked and is beginning a new execution cycle
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initializes its display control settings before sending any screen output
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Screen Erase Flag (SEND-ERASE-YES) must be set to YES, enabling a full screen erase and redraw when the Authorization Detail screen is subsequently sent to the user

rules.rule_name: Clear Internal Message Field at Program Startup
rules.rule_description: At the beginning of every program execution cycle, the internal working storage message field must be cleared to spaces to ensure no residual message text from a prior interaction is inadvertently carried forward and displayed to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Working Storage
Message Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail View program has just been invoked and is beginning a new execution cycle
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initializes its internal message storage before performing any business processing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The working storage message field (WS-MESSAGE) must be set to spaces (blank), ensuring it contains no residual message content from any prior program execution

rules.rule_name: Clear Screen Error Message Display Field at Program Startup
rules.rule_description: At the beginning of every program execution cycle, the error message display field on the Authorization Detail screen must be cleared to spaces, ensuring no prior error message is visible to the user when the screen is refreshed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Screen Error
Message Display Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail View program has just been invoked and is beginning a new execution cycle
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initializes its screen output fields before sending any display to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen error message display field (ERRMSGO on screen map COPAU1AO) must be set to spaces (blank), ensuring no prior error message text is carried over and displayed on the Authorization Detail screen

key_functionalities.title: New Session Redirect
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Accesses\nAuthorization Detail Screen])
    B{Is this a\nNew Session?\nNo prior session data}
    C[Initialize a fresh\nCommunication Area]
    D[Set destination to\nAuthorization Summary Screen]
    E[Record current screen\nas the originating screen]
    F[Reset program context\nto fresh entry state]
    G([Redirect User to\nAuthorization Summary Screen])
    H([Continue with\nNormal Screen Processing])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - No Session Data Exists| C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    B -->|No - Session Data Exists| H

rules.rule_name: Detect New Session on Authorization Detail Screen Access
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the user is accessing the Authorization Detail screen for the first time without any prior session context, by checking if a communication area exists from a previous interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this a New Session? No prior session data

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user attempts to access the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.When: No prior session communication area exists (session data length is zero, indicating no prior interaction data was passed)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies this as a new session and initiates the new session redirect workflow, bypassing normal screen processing

rules.rule_name: Initialize Fresh Communication Area for New Session
rules.rule_description: When a new session is detected, the system initializes a clean communication area to ensure no stale or residual data from any prior session is carried forward into the redirect process.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize a fresh Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined this is a new session with no prior session data
acceptance_criteria.When: The new session redirect workflow is initiated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The entire CardDemo communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is initialized to its default empty state, clearing all fields including account ID, customer ID, program context, and any previously selected authorization data

rules.rule_name: Set Redirect Destination to Authorization Summary Screen
rules.rule_description: When a new session is detected on the Authorization Detail screen, the system sets the target destination program to the Authorization Summary screen, as the user must first select an authorization from the summary before viewing its details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set destination to Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new session has been detected and the communication area has been initialized
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to redirect the user away from the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The destination program in the communication area (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) is set to the Authorization Summary program (WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY), directing the user to the summary list screen

rules.rule_name: Record Authorization Detail Screen as the Originating Screen
rules.rule_description: Before redirecting the user, the system records the Authorization Detail screen's transaction ID and program name as the originating screen in the communication area, so the destination screen knows where the navigation came from.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record current screen as the originating screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to redirect the user to the Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The return-to-previous-screen process is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current transaction ID (WS-CICS-TRANID) is recorded in the communication area field CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, and the Authorization Detail program name (WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL) is recorded in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, establishing the Authorization Detail screen as the originating screen for navigation tracking

rules.rule_name: Reset Program Context to Fresh Entry State
rules.rule_description: Before redirecting the user, the system resets the program context indicators to represent a clean, first-time entry state, ensuring the destination Authorization Summary screen treats this as a fresh navigation rather than a return from a sub-screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Reset program context to fresh entry state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The originating screen information has been recorded in the communication area
acceptance_criteria.When: The system finalizes the redirect preparation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program context field (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT) is set to zeros (no context), and the program entry state flag (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER) is set to TRUE, indicating a fresh first-time entry to the destination program

rules.rule_name: Redirect User to Authorization Summary Screen
rules.rule_description: After all redirect preparation steps are complete, the system transfers control to the Authorization Summary screen, passing the initialized communication area, so the user can select an authorization record before accessing its details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Redirect User to Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The communication area has been initialized, the destination is set to Authorization Summary, the originating screen is recorded, and the program context is reset to fresh entry state
acceptance_criteria.When: The redirect is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: Control is immediately transferred (via XCTL) to the Authorization Summary program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) with the prepared communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) passed along, and the Authorization Detail screen is not displayed to the user

rules.rule_name: Validate Account ID and Authorization Selection Before Loading Detail
rules.rule_description: Before reading any authorization records, the system must verify that a valid numeric Account ID exists and that a specific authorization has been selected. If either condition fails, no data is loaded and an error state is set.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account ID and Selected Authorization Key Valid?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has navigated to the Authorization Detail screen for the first time
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether the Account ID is numeric AND the Selected Authorization Key is not blank and not low-values
acceptance_criteria.Then: If both conditions are met, the system proceeds to read the authorization records using the Account ID and Authorization Key; if either condition fails, an error flag is set and no authorization data is displayed on screen

rules.rule_name: Read Authorization Summary Record by Account ID
rules.rule_description: The system retrieves the Authorization Summary record from the database using the Account ID as the key. If the summary record is not found, an error state is set and no detail data is displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Authorization Summary Record using Account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account ID and Authorization Key have been validated as present and valid
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve the Authorization Summary record from the Pending Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) using the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the summary record is found, the system proceeds to read the Authorization Detail record; if the summary record is not found or the end of the database is reached, an error flag is set and no authorization data is displayed on screen

rules.rule_name: Read Authorization Detail Record by Authorization Key
rules.rule_description: After successfully retrieving the Authorization Summary, the system retrieves the specific Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key. If the detail record is not found, an error state is set.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Authorization Detail Record using Authorization Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved for the given Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve the Authorization Detail record from the Pending Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1) using the Selected Authorization Key
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the detail record is found, the system proceeds to format and display the authorization details; if the detail record is not found or the end of the database is reached, an error flag is set and no authorization data is displayed on screen

rules.rule_name: Format Authorization Origination Date for Display
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination date stored in the system in YYMMDD format must be reformatted into MM/DD/YY format before being displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Authorization Date YYMMDD to MM/DD/YY

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is not set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the authorization origination date for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization origination date stored as YYMMDD is reformatted so that characters 1-2 (YY) map to the year portion, characters 3-4 (MM) map to the month portion, and characters 5-6 (DD) map to the day portion, resulting in a display date in MM/DD/YY format shown in the Authorization Date field (AUTHDTO)

rules.rule_name: Format Authorization Origination Time for Display
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination time stored in the system must be formatted with colon separators (HH:MM:SS) before being displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Authorization Time with Colon Separators

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is not set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the authorization origination time for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization origination time is formatted by placing characters 1-2 (HH) into positions 1-2 of the display time field, characters 3-4 (MM) into positions 4-5, and characters 5-6 (SS) into positions 7-8, with colon separators at positions 3 and 6, resulting in HH:MM:SS format shown in the Authorization Time field (AUTHTMO)

rules.rule_name: Format Card Expiry Date with Slash Separator
rules.rule_description: The card expiry date stored in the system must be formatted with a slash separator (MM/YY) before being displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Card Expiry Date with Slash Separator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is not set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the card expiry date for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card expiry date is formatted by placing characters 1-2 (MM) into positions 1-2 of the display field, a literal '/' into position 3, and characters 3-4 (YY) into positions 4-5, resulting in MM/YY format shown in the Card Expiry Date field (CRDEXPO)

rules.rule_name: Determine Authorization Approval or Decline Status and Color
rules.rule_description: The authorization response code determines whether the transaction was approved or declined, and the screen must display the status with a corresponding color indicator to visually distinguish approved from declined authorizations.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Response Code = '00'?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is not set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the Authorization Response Code
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the response code is '00', the Authorization Status field (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'A' (Approved) and displayed in GREEN; if the response code is any value other than '00', the Authorization Status field (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'D' (Declined) and displayed in RED

rules.rule_name: Lookup and Display Decline Reason Description from Reason Code Table
rules.rule_description: The authorization response reason code must be looked up in the predefined Decline Reason table to retrieve a human-readable description. If the reason code is not found in the table, a default error indicator is displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Lookup Decline Reason Description from Reason Code Table

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is not set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the Decline Reason Table for a matching entry where the decline code equals the Authorization Response Reason code
acceptance_criteria.Then: If a matching entry is found, the Authorization Reason field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with the response reason code followed by a '-' separator and the corresponding decline description from the table; if no matching entry is found, the Authorization Reason field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with '9999' followed by '-' and 'ERROR' to indicate an unrecognized decline reason

rules.rule_name: Display Fraud Status Flag and Report Date
rules.rule_description: The fraud status field on the Authorization Detail screen must reflect whether the authorization has any fraud history, displaying the fraud flag and report date when applicable, or a dash when no fraud history exists.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Fraud Status Confirmed or Removed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is not set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the fraud status of the authorization record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the authorization fraud status is Confirmed OR Removed (indicating the authorization has a fraud history), the Fraud Status field (AUTHFRDO) is populated with the fraud flag indicator in position 1, a '-' separator in position 2, and the Fraud Report Date starting at position 3; if the authorization has no fraud history (neither confirmed nor removed), the Fraud Status field (AUTHFRDO) is populated with only a '-'

rules.rule_name: Populate Remaining Authorization Detail Fields on Screen
rules.rule_description: All remaining authorization and merchant detail fields must be populated on the Authorization Detail screen from the retrieved authorization record when no error condition exists.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Remaining Screen Fields Card Number, Amount, Processing Code, POS Entry Mode, Message Source, Merchant Category Code, Auth Type, Transaction ID, Match Status, Merchant Name, ID, City, State, Zip

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is not set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the remaining fields on the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following fields are populated directly from the Authorization Detail record: Card Number (CARDNUMO), Approved Amount (AUTHAMTO), Processing Code (AUTHCDO), POS Entry Mode (POSEMDO), Message Source (AUTHSRCO), Merchant Category Code (MCCCDO), Authorization Type (AUTHTYPO), Transaction ID (TRNIDO), Match Status (AUTHMTCO), Merchant Name (MERNAMEO), Merchant ID (MERIDO), Merchant City (MERCITYO), Merchant State (MERSTO), and Merchant Zip (MERZIPO)

rules.rule_name: Populate Screen Header with Current Date, Time, and Program Information
rules.rule_description: Every time the Authorization Detail screen is displayed, the screen header must be refreshed with the current system date and time, along with the application title, transaction name, and program name.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Screen Header Title, Transaction ID, Program Name, Current Date and Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen is about to be sent to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen header information
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen header is populated with: Application Title Line 1 (TITLE01O) from the application title constant, Application Title Line 2 (TITLE02O) from the application title constant, Transaction Name (TRNNAMEO) from the current CICS transaction ID, Program Name (PGMNAMEO) set to the Authorization Detail program name, Current Date (CURDATEO) formatted as MM/DD/YY from the current system date, and Current Time (CURTIMEO) formatted as HH:MM:SS from the current system time

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Detail Screen with Full Refresh
rules.rule_description: On first entry to the Authorization Detail screen, the screen must be sent with a full erase to ensure a clean display, clearing any previously displayed data before showing the current authorization details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Authorization Detail Screen - Full Refresh

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen data has been fully populated and the screen send flag is set to ERASE
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Detail screen (map COPAU1A from mapset COPAU01) to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is displayed with a full ERASE, clearing all previously displayed content, and the cursor is positioned at the Card Number field (CARDNUML set to -1), ensuring the user sees a completely refreshed Authorization Detail screen

key_functionalities.title: Screen Navigation Handling
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

    A([Screen Navigation Handling\nUser Presses a Key])
    B{Which Key\nWas Pressed?}
    C[Enter Key\nRefresh current authorization\ndetail view]

    B -->|Enter| C
