    C --> H
    E --> H
    F --> H
    G --> H
    H --> I
    D --> I

rules.rule_name: Enter Key Triggers Authorization Detail Refresh
rules.rule_description: When the user presses the Enter key on the Authorization Detail screen, the system re-processes and refreshes the currently selected authorization record details and redisplays the updated Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Enter Key
Refresh current authorization
detail view

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen with a valid Account ID (numeric) and a pending authorization record selected (not spaces or low-values)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the Enter key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads the authorization record for the selected Account ID and Authorization Key, populates all authorization detail fields on the screen (card number, authorization date, authorization time, approved amount, response status, decline reason, processing code, POS entry mode, message source, merchant category code, card expiry date, authorization type, transaction ID, match status, fraud status, merchant details), and redisplays the Authorization Detail screen with the refreshed data

rules.rule_name: Enter Key with Missing or Invalid Selection Sets Error State
rules.rule_description: When the user presses the Enter key but either the Account ID is not numeric or no authorization record has been selected, the system sets an error condition and does not populate authorization detail fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Enter Key
Refresh current authorization
detail view

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the Enter key AND either the Account ID is not numeric OR no authorization record is selected (value is spaces or low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets an error flag ON, skips population of all authorization detail fields, and redisplays the Authorization Detail screen without authorization data

rules.rule_name: PF3 Key Returns User to Authorization Summary Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system navigates the user back to the Authorization Summary screen, preserving the session context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
PF3 Key
Return to Authorization
Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the destination program to the Authorization Summary program, records the current transaction ID and Authorization Detail program name as the originating context, resets the program context to initial entry state, and transfers control to the Authorization Summary screen

rules.rule_name: PF5 Key Invokes Fraud Mark or Removal Processing
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF5 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system toggles the fraud status of the currently displayed authorization — confirming it as fraud if not already flagged, or removing the fraud flag if already confirmed — and redisplays the updated Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
PF5 Key
Mark or Remove
Fraud on Authorization

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen with a pending authorization record currently displayed
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF5 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs fraud mark or removal processing on the current authorization record and redisplays the Authorization Detail screen reflecting the updated fraud status and a confirmation or error message

rules.rule_name: PF8 Key Navigates to Next Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system advances to the next pending authorization record for the same account and displays its details, or informs the user if no further records exist.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
PF8 Key
Navigate to Next
Authorization Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen viewing a pending authorization record for a specific account
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF8 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads the current authorization record, then reads the next sequential authorization record for the same account; if a next record exists, the system updates the selected authorization to the next record and displays its full details on the Authorization Detail screen; if no next record exists (end of list), the system displays the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' and refreshes the screen without erasing the currently displayed authorization data

rules.rule_name: Unrecognized Key Press Displays Invalid Key Message
rules.rule_description: When the user presses any key other than Enter, PF3, PF5, or PF8 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system displays an invalid key message and refreshes the screen without changing any authorization data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Any Other Key
Display Invalid Key
Message to User

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key that is not Enter, PF3, PF5, or PF8
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system re-processes the current authorization data (same as Enter key behavior), sets the screen message to the standard 'Invalid Key' message text, and redisplays the Authorization Detail screen with the invalid key notification — no authorization data is changed

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Screen Redisplayed After Key Processing
rules.rule_description: After processing any key action (Enter, PF5, PF8, or Other), the system always refreshes and redisplays the Authorization Detail screen with updated header information including current system date and time.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Updated
Authorization Detail Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed processing for a key press (Enter, PF5, PF8, or any other key — excluding PF3)
acceptance_criteria.When: The Authorization Detail screen is about to be sent to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with the current system date (MM/DD/YY format) and current system time (HH:MM:SS format), along with the application title, transaction name, and program name; any message (error, confirmation, or invalid key) is placed in the message field; the cursor is positioned on the card number field; and the screen is displayed — using full screen erase if the erase flag is set to YES, or without erase if set to NO (e.g., when already at last authorization)

key_functionalities.title: Return to Authorization Summary
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF3 Key])
    B[Set Destination as\nAuthorization Summary Screen]
    C[Record Current Transaction ID\nas the Originating Transaction]
    D[Record Current Program\nas the Originating Program]
    E[Reset Program Context\nto Fresh Entry State]
    F[Transfer Control to\nAuthorization Summary Screen]
    G([Authorization Summary\nScreen Displayed])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G

rules.rule_name: Set Authorization Summary as Navigation Destination on PF3
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system designates the Authorization Summary screen as the target destination for navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Destination as Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen and has an active session with valid communication area data
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF3 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the Authorization Summary program (WS-PGM-AUTH-SMRY) as the destination program in the communication area (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM), indicating where control should be transferred

rules.rule_name: Record Originating Transaction ID Before Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before navigating away from the Authorization Detail screen, the system records the current transaction identifier so the destination screen knows which transaction initiated the navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record Current Transaction ID as the Originating Transaction

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF3 and the destination has been set to the Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to transfer control to the Authorization Summary screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the current CICS Transaction ID (WS-CICS-TRANID) into the communication area field CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, preserving the originating transaction identity for the receiving screen

rules.rule_name: Record Originating Program Name Before Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before transferring control, the system records the name of the current Authorization Detail program so the Authorization Summary screen can identify which program initiated the navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record Current Program as the Originating Program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to navigate back to the Authorization Summary screen after PF3 was pressed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system builds the navigation context in the communication area
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the current Authorization Detail program name (WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL) into the communication area field CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, identifying the Authorization Detail screen as the originating program

rules.rule_name: Reset Program Context to Fresh Entry State Before Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before transferring control to the Authorization Summary screen, the system resets the program context so the destination screen treats the incoming navigation as a fresh entry rather than a re-entry, ensuring a clean initial display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Reset Program Context to Fresh Entry State

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to transfer control to the Authorization Summary screen after PF3 was pressed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system finalizes the navigation context in the communication area
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the program context value (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT) to zeros AND sets the program entry state flag (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER) to TRUE, ensuring the Authorization Summary screen initializes as a fresh entry with no prior state carried over

rules.rule_name: Transfer Control to Authorization Summary Screen
rules.rule_description: After preparing all navigation context data, the system transfers full control to the Authorization Summary screen, passing the complete session communication area so the destination screen has all necessary context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Transfer Control to Authorization Summary Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The destination program has been set to Authorization Summary, the originating transaction ID and program name have been recorded, and the program context has been reset to fresh entry state
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the screen transfer
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system transfers control (XCTL) to the Authorization Summary program identified in CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, passing the full communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) containing the originating transaction ID, originating program name, and fresh entry state — resulting in the Authorization Summary screen being displayed to the user

key_functionalities.title: Mark/Unmark Authorization as Fraud
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([PF5 Key Pressed]) --> B[Read Current Authorization Record\nfrom Database]
    B --> C{Is Authorization\nAlready Marked as Fraud?}
    C -->|Yes - Currently Fraud| D[Set Status to Fraud Removed]
    C -->|No - Not Currently Fraud| E[Set Status to Fraud Confirmed]
    D --> F[Prepare Fraud Data Package\nwith Authorization Details,\nAccount ID and Customer ID]
    E --> F
    F --> G[Delegate to Fraud\nProcessing Program COPAUS2C]
    G --> H{Fraud Program\nReturned Success?}
    H -->|Yes - Success| I[Save Updated Fraud Status\nand Report Date to Database]
    I --> J{Save\nSuccessful?}
    J -->|Yes| K[Commit Changes]
    K --> L{Which Action\nWas Taken?}
    L -->|Fraud Confirmed| M[Display Message:\n'AUTH MARKED FRAUD']
    L -->|Fraud Removed| N[Display Message:\n'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED']
    J -->|No - Save Failed| O[Rollback All Changes]
    H -->|No - Failure| P[Rollback All Changes]
    P --> Q[Display Error Message\nReturned from Fraud Program]
    O --> Q
    M --> R[Refresh Authorization\nDetail Screen]
    N --> R
    Q --> R
    R --> S([Return to Screen])

rules.rule_name: Toggle Fraud Status of Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: When a user presses PF5 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system evaluates the current fraud status of the authorization and toggles it: if already marked as fraud, the fraud flag is removed; if not marked as fraud, it is confirmed as fraud.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Authorization Already Marked as Fraud?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is viewing an authorization detail record on the Authorization Detail screen and presses PF5
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the current authorization record and evaluates its fraud status flag
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the authorization is currently marked as Fraud Confirmed, the system sets the fraud status to Fraud Removed and flags the action as 'Remove Fraud'; if the authorization is NOT currently marked as fraud, the system sets the fraud status to Fraud Confirmed and flags the action as 'Report Fraud'

rules.rule_name: Prepare Fraud Data Package for External Processing
rules.rule_description: Before delegating to the external fraud processing program, the system assembles a fraud data package containing the full authorization detail record, the Account ID, and the Customer ID associated with the authorization.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Prepare Fraud Data Package with Authorization Details, Account ID and Customer ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud status toggle has been determined (either Fraud Confirmed or Fraud Removed) for the current authorization record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the data package to send to the external fraud program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the fraud data package with: the complete authorization detail record (all authorization fields), the Account ID from the current session, and the Customer ID from the current session

rules.rule_name: Delegate Fraud Status Update to External Fraud Processing Program
rules.rule_description: The system delegates the fraud status update operation to the external Fraud Processing Program (COPAUS2C), passing the assembled fraud data package for processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Delegate to Fraud Processing Program COPAUS2C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud data package has been prepared with the authorization details, Account ID, and Customer ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system invokes the external Fraud Processing Program by passing the fraud data package
acceptance_criteria.Then: The external Fraud Processing Program (COPAUS2C) is called with the complete fraud data package, and the system waits for the program to return a success or failure response

rules.rule_name: Evaluate Fraud Program Response to Determine Next Action
rules.rule_description: After the external fraud program completes, the system evaluates whether the call was successful and whether the fraud update was applied, to determine whether to proceed with saving the update or to rollback all changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Fraud Program Returned Success?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program has been called with the fraud data package
acceptance_criteria.When: The system receives the response from the external Fraud Processing Program
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the program call completed successfully AND the fraud update was confirmed as successful by the fraud program, the system proceeds to save the updated fraud status to the database; if the program call completed successfully BUT the fraud update was NOT successful, the system rolls back all changes and displays the error message returned by the fraud program; if the program call itself failed (non-normal response), the system rolls back all changes

rules.rule_name: Save Updated Fraud Status to Authorization Database
rules.rule_description: When the external fraud program confirms a successful update, the system saves the updated authorization record (including the new fraud status and fraud report date) back to the authorization details database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save Updated Fraud Status and Report Date to Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program has confirmed a successful fraud status update
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to save the updated authorization record to the database
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system writes the updated authorization detail record (containing the new fraud status flag and fraud report date) to the authorization details database segment; if the save is successful, the system proceeds to commit the changes; if the save fails, the system rolls back all changes

rules.rule_name: Commit Fraud Status Changes on Successful Database Save
rules.rule_description: When the authorization record has been successfully updated in the database with the new fraud status, the system commits all changes to make them permanent.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Commit Changes

acceptance_criteria.Given: The updated authorization record with the new fraud status has been successfully saved to the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms the database save was successful
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system commits all pending changes, making the fraud status update permanent and irreversible until a future action changes it

rules.rule_name: Display Confirmation Message When Authorization is Marked as Fraud
rules.rule_description: After successfully committing a fraud confirmation, the system displays a confirmation message to inform the user that the authorization has been marked as fraud.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Message: 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud status update has been committed successfully and the action taken was to confirm fraud (not remove it)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines that the fraud action was a fraud confirmation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' on the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Display Confirmation Message When Authorization Fraud Flag is Removed
rules.rule_description: After successfully committing a fraud removal, the system displays a confirmation message to inform the user that the fraud flag has been removed from the authorization.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Message: 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud status update has been committed successfully and the action taken was to remove the fraud flag
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines that the fraud action was a fraud removal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' on the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Rollback All Changes When Database Save of Fraud Status Fails
rules.rule_description: If the system fails to save the updated fraud status to the authorization database, all changes made during the fraud toggle operation are rolled back to preserve data integrity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No - Save Failed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program confirmed a successful update, but the system's attempt to save the updated authorization record to the database failed
acceptance_criteria.When: The database save operation returns a non-successful status
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system rolls back all changes made during the current fraud toggle operation, ensuring no partial updates are retained in the database

rules.rule_name: Rollback All Changes and Display Error When Fraud Program Fails
rules.rule_description: If the external Fraud Processing Program returns a failure (either the program call itself failed or the program reported an unsuccessful update), all changes are rolled back and the error message from the fraud program is displayed to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No - Failure

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program was called with the fraud data package
acceptance_criteria.When: The fraud program call fails (non-normal system response) OR the fraud program returns an unsuccessful update status
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system rolls back all changes made during the current fraud toggle operation; if the fraud program returned an error message, that specific error message is displayed on the Authorization Detail screen to inform the user of the reason for failure

sub_functionalities.title: Read Current Authorization Record from Database
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Read Authorization Record])
    B[Use Account ID to retrieve\nAuthorization Summary Record]
    C{Summary Record\nFound?}
    D[Mark as End of Records\nNo further processing]
    E[Use Authorization Key to retrieve\nAuthorization Detail Record]
    F{Detail Record\nFound?}
    G[Mark as End of Records\nNo further processing]
    H[Mark Record as Successfully Retrieved]
    I([End: Authorization Record Retrieved])
    J([End: No Record Found])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C -->|Yes - Summary Found| E
    C -->|No - Summary Not Found| D
    D --> J
    E --> F
    F -->|Yes - Detail Found| H
    F -->|No - Detail Not Found| G
    G --> J
    H --> I

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Authorization Summary Record Using Account ID
rules.rule_description: When reading an authorization record, the system first retrieves the Authorization Summary record from the database using the Account ID as the search key. This is the mandatory first step before any authorization detail can be accessed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Account ID to retrieve Authorization Summary Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Account ID is available in the current session and an authorization record read has been initiated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve the Authorization Summary record from the Pending Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID as the unique search key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Summary record matching the provided Account ID is retrieved and made available for the subsequent Authorization Detail retrieval step; the record retrieval status is captured for independent evaluation

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Record Found - Proceed to Detail Retrieval
rules.rule_description: After attempting to retrieve the Authorization Summary record, the system independently evaluates the retrieval status. Only when the summary record is successfully found does the system proceed to retrieve the Authorization Detail record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Summary Record Found?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to retrieve the Authorization Summary record using the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns a successful status indicating the Authorization Summary record was found
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the record set as 'not end of records' and proceeds to retrieve the Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Record Not Found - Mark End of Records
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary record cannot be found for the given Account ID, the system marks the end of records condition and stops further processing of the authorization record retrieval. No Authorization Detail retrieval is attempted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No - Summary Not Found

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to retrieve the Authorization Summary record using the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns a 'record not found' status or an 'end of database' status for the Authorization Summary retrieval
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization record set as 'end of records', no Authorization Detail retrieval is attempted, and the read operation concludes with no record available

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Authorization Detail Record Using Authorization Key
rules.rule_description: Only after successfully retrieving the Authorization Summary record, the system retrieves the Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key as the search criterion. This is a dependent second step that only executes when the summary record was found.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Authorization Key to retrieve Authorization Detail Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved for the given Account ID and the record set is marked as 'not end of records'
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to retrieve the Authorization Detail record from the Pending Authorization Detail data store using the Authorization Key as the search criterion, within the context of the previously retrieved summary
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Detail record matching the provided Authorization Key is retrieved and made available for display and processing; the detail retrieval status is captured independently for evaluation

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Record Found - Mark Successful Retrieval
rules.rule_description: After attempting to retrieve the Authorization Detail record, the system independently evaluates the detail retrieval status. When the detail record is successfully found, the overall authorization record retrieval is marked as successfully completed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Yes - Detail Found

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record was successfully retrieved and the system has attempted to retrieve the Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns a successful status indicating the Authorization Detail record was found
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization record set as 'not end of records' and the complete authorization record (both summary and detail) is considered successfully retrieved and available for display

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Record Not Found - Mark End of Records
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Detail record cannot be found for the given Authorization Key (even though the summary was found), the system marks the end of records condition. This is an independent status check separate from the summary record check.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No - Detail Not Found

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record was successfully retrieved and the system has attempted to retrieve the Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns a 'record not found' status or an 'end of database' status for the Authorization Detail retrieval
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization record set as 'end of records' and the read operation concludes with no complete authorization record available for display

rules.rule_name: Two-Step Sequential Authorization Record Retrieval with Independent Status Checks
rules.rule_description: The complete authorization record retrieval is a mandatory two-step sequential process: first the Authorization Summary must be found using Account ID, and only then is the Authorization Detail retrieved using the Authorization Key. Each step has its own independent success/failure evaluation, and the second step is only attempted when the first step succeeds.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve authorization summary using account ID then retrieve authorization detail using authorization key, with independent status checks for each database read

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record read has been initiated with a valid Account ID and Authorization Key available in the current session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the two-step retrieval: Step 1 - retrieve Authorization Summary by Account ID; Step 2 (conditional on Step 1 success) - retrieve Authorization Detail by Authorization Key; each step independently evaluates its retrieval outcome
acceptance_criteria.Then: If both steps succeed, the full authorization record is marked as successfully retrieved and available; if either step fails to find a record (not found or end of data), the record set is marked as 'end of records' and no further retrieval is attempted for that step or any subsequent step

key_functionalities.title: Navigate to Next Authorization
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF8\nNavigate to Next Authorization])
    B[Retrieve Current Authorization Record\nPosition to current record in database]
    C[Fetch Next Sequential\nAuthorization Detail Record]
    D{More Authorization\nRecords Available?}
    E[Update Selected Authorization\nto Next Record Key]
    F[Populate Screen with\nNew Authorization Details\nCard Number, Date, Time, Amount,\nResponse Code, Fraud Status,\nMerchant Information, etc.]
    G[Display Message:\n'Already at the last Authorization...'\nScreen remains unchanged]
    H[Send Updated Authorization\nDetail Screen to User]
    I([Display Complete])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D -->|Yes - Next Record Found| E
    E --> F
    F --> H
    D -->|No - End of Records| G
    G --> H
    H --> I

rules.rule_name: Position to Current Authorization Record Before Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before navigating to the next authorization, the system must first position itself to the currently selected authorization record using the account ID and the currently selected authorization key, so that the next sequential record can be correctly identified.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Retrieve Current Authorization Record
Position to current record in database

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is viewing an authorization detail screen and presses PF8 to navigate to the next authorization, and the session contains a valid Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and a currently selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates the next-authorization navigation process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system uses the current Account ID and the currently selected Authorization Key to locate and position to the current authorization record in the Pending Authorization database, establishing the correct starting position for fetching the next sequential record

rules.rule_name: Fetch Next Sequential Authorization Detail Record
rules.rule_description: After positioning to the current authorization record, the system fetches the next sequential authorization detail record for the same account from the Pending Authorization database without applying any specific key filter, relying on sequential order.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fetch Next Sequential
Authorization Detail Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully positioned to the current authorization detail record for the account in the Pending Authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system requests the next sequential authorization detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the immediately following authorization detail record in sequence for the same account; if a next record exists, the end-of-records indicator is set to NOT-EOF; if no further records exist (end of data or segment not found), the end-of-records indicator is set to EOF

rules.rule_name: Determine Availability of Next Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: After attempting to fetch the next authorization record, the system evaluates whether a next record was successfully retrieved or whether the end of the authorization list has been reached, to determine the appropriate action to take.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
More Authorization
Records Available?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to fetch the next sequential authorization detail record for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the fetch operation
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the fetch was successful (STATUS-OK), the end-of-records indicator is set to NOT-EOF and the system proceeds to display the next authorization; if the fetch returned segment-not-found or end-of-database, the end-of-records indicator is set to EOF and the system displays the end-of-list message

rules.rule_name: Update Selected Authorization Key to Next Record
rules.rule_description: When a next authorization record is successfully retrieved, the system updates the session's currently selected authorization key to reflect the newly retrieved authorization record, so that subsequent operations reference the correct record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Update Selected Authorization
to Next Record Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully fetched the next sequential authorization detail record (end-of-records indicator is NOT-EOF)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to display the next authorization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The session's currently selected authorization key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED) is updated with the Authorization Key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) from the newly retrieved authorization detail record

rules.rule_name: Display End-of-List Message When No Further Authorizations Exist
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate past the last authorization record in the list, the system informs the user that no further authorizations are available and retains the current screen content without erasing it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Message:
'Already at the last Authorization...'
Screen remains unchanged

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 to navigate to the next authorization and the system determines that no further authorization records exist (end-of-records indicator is EOF)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the end-of-list condition
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the screen erase flag to NO (so the current screen content is preserved and not cleared), and sets the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' to be displayed to the user on the refreshed screen

rules.rule_name: Populate Authorization Date in MM/DD/YY Display Format
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination date stored in the system in YYMMDD format must be reformatted into MM/DD/YY format before being displayed on the authorization detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen with
New Authorization Details
Card Number, Date, Time, Amount,
Response Code, Fraud Status,
Merchant Information, etc.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail screen fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization origination date stored as YYMMDD is reformatted by extracting characters 1-2 as Year (YY), characters 3-4 as Month (MM), and characters 5-6 as Day (DD), and the date is displayed on screen in MM/DD/YY format

rules.rule_name: Populate Authorization Time in HH:MM:SS Display Format
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination time stored in the system must be formatted into HH:MM:SS format before being displayed on the authorization detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen with
New Authorization Details
Card Number, Date, Time, Amount,
Response Code, Fraud Status,
Merchant Information, etc.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization time field on screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization origination time is formatted by placing characters 1-2 into positions 1-2 (hours), characters 3-4 into positions 4-5 (minutes), and characters 5-6 into positions 7-8 (seconds) of the display time field, resulting in HH:MM:SS format

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Approval or Decline Status with Color Indicator
rules.rule_description: The authorization response code determines whether the transaction was approved or declined, and the screen must display the appropriate status indicator with a corresponding color to visually distinguish approvals from declines.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen with
New Authorization Details
Card Number, Date, Time, Amount,
Response Code, Fraud Status,
Merchant Information, etc.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) to determine the transaction outcome
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the response code is '00', the status field (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'A' (Approved) and displayed in GREEN; if the response code is any value other than '00', the status field is set to 'D' (Declined) and displayed in RED

rules.rule_name: Look Up and Display Decline Reason Description
rules.rule_description: The authorization response reason code must be looked up in the predefined Decline Reason table to retrieve a human-readable description, which is then displayed alongside the reason code on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen with
New Authorization Details
Card Number, Date, Time, Amount,
Response Code, Fraud Status,
Merchant Information, etc.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the Decline Reason table (WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB) for a matching entry where the decline code (DECL-CODE) equals the authorization response reason (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If a matching entry is found, the decline reason field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with the reason code in positions 1-4, a '-' separator in position 5, and the decline description (DECL-DESC) from position 6 onward (e.g., '1001-INSUFFICIENT FUNDS'); if no matching entry is found, the field is populated with '9999' in positions 1-4, '-' in position 5, and 'ERROR' from position 6 onward (i.e., '9999-ERROR')

rules.rule_name: Format Card Expiry Date with Slash Separator for Display
rules.rule_description: The card expiry date stored in the system must be formatted with a '/' separator between the month and year portions before being displayed on the authorization detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen with
New Authorization Details
Card Number, Date, Time, Amount,
Response Code, Fraud Status,
Merchant Information, etc.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the card expiry date display field (CRDEXPO)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card expiry date is displayed in MM/YY format by placing the first 2 characters of PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE into positions 1-2 (month), a '/' character into position 3, and the last 2 characters of PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE into positions 4-5 (year)

rules.rule_name: Display Fraud Status with Flag and Report Date When Fraud History Exists
rules.rule_description: The fraud status field on the authorization detail screen must reflect whether the authorization has any fraud history, displaying the fraud flag and report date when applicable, or a neutral indicator when no fraud history exists.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen with
New Authorization Details
Card Number, Date, Time, Amount,
Response Code, Fraud Status,
Merchant Information, etc.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the fraud status of the authorization record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the authorization has been confirmed as fraud (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED) OR has had its fraud flag removed (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED), the fraud display field (AUTHFRDO) is populated with the fraud flag indicator (PA-AUTH-FRAUD) in position 1, a '-' separator in position 2, and the fraud report date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE) from position 3 onward; if neither condition is true (no fraud history), the fraud display field is set to '-' only

rules.rule_name: Populate All Remaining Authorization Detail Fields for Display
rules.rule_description: When a next authorization record is successfully retrieved, all authorization and merchant detail fields must be populated on the screen from the retrieved record data, provided no error condition exists.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen with
New Authorization Details
Card Number, Date, Time, Amount,
Response Code, Fraud Status,
Merchant Information, etc.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following fields are populated from the retrieved authorization record: Card Number (PA-CARD-NUM → CARDNUMO), Approved Amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT → AUTHAMTO), Processing Code (PA-PROCESSING-CODE → AUTHCDO), POS Entry Mode (PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE → POSEMDO), Message Source (PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE → AUTHSRCO), Merchant Category Code (PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE → MCCCDO), Authorization Type (PA-AUTH-TYPE → AUTHTYPO), Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID → TRNIDO), Match Status (PA-MATCH-STATUS → AUTHMTCO), Merchant Name (PA-MERCHANT-NAME → MERNAMEO), Merchant ID (PA-MERCHANT-ID → MERIDO), Merchant City (PA-MERCHANT-CITY → MERCITYO), Merchant State (PA-MERCHANT-STATE → MERSTO), and Merchant ZIP (PA-MERCHANT-ZIP → MERZIPO)

key_functionalities.title: Invalid Key Handling
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses\nUnsupported Function Key])
    B[Load Current Authorization\nDetail Record]
    C[Set Invalid Key\nMessage for Display]
    D[Display Authorization Detail\nScreen with Invalid Key Message]
    E([Return to\nAuthorization Detail Screen])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E

rules.rule_name: Detect Unsupported Function Key Press on Authorization Detail Screen
rules.rule_description: When a user presses any function key that is not ENTER, PF3, PF5, or PF8 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system identifies it as an unsupported/invalid key action and triggers the invalid key handling workflow.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: User Presses Unsupported Function Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen and has an active session with a previously selected authorization record
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF5, or PF8
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies the key press as unsupported and initiates the invalid key handling process, which includes reloading the current authorization record and displaying an invalid key message

rules.rule_name: Reload Current Authorization Detail Record on Invalid Key Press
rules.rule_description: When an unsupported key is pressed, the system reloads the current authorization detail record using the existing Account ID and selected Authorization key from the session, ensuring the screen retains all previously displayed authorization information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Load Current Authorization Detail Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed an unsupported function key on the Authorization Detail screen, and the session contains a valid numeric Account ID and a previously selected Authorization record key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the invalid key event by re-executing the authorization record retrieval
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads the authorization summary record for the Account ID and retrieves the matching authorization detail record using the Authorization key; if the Account ID is not numeric or no authorization is selected, an error flag is set and no authorization details are loaded

rules.rule_name: Set Invalid Key Message for Display
rules.rule_description: After detecting an unsupported key press, the system sets the standard invalid key message (sourced from the application message constants CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) into the screen message field to inform the user that the key they pressed is not a supported action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Invalid Key Message for Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has detected that the user pressed an unsupported function key and has reloaded the current authorization detail record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Authorization Detail screen for redisplay
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the message field to the standard invalid key message defined in the application constants (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY), which will be displayed in the error message area of the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Detail Screen with Invalid Key Message
rules.rule_description: The Authorization Detail screen is refreshed and redisplayed to the user with the invalid key message shown in the error message area, along with the current authorization details and an updated header showing the current system date and time.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Authorization Detail Screen with Invalid Key Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The invalid key message has been set and the current authorization detail record has been loaded into the screen output fields
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Detail screen back to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen is displayed with: (1) the invalid key error message shown in the error message area (ERRMSGO), (2) all current authorization detail fields populated as previously displayed, (3) the screen header updated with the current system date (MM/DD/YY) and current system time (HH:MM:SS), (4) the transaction name and program name shown in the header, and (5) the screen is sent with ERASE to fully refresh the display

key_functionalities.title: Authorization Record Retrieval
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD

    C{Authorization\nSummary Found?}

    F{Authorization\nDetail Found?}
    G[Mark as End of Records\nNo Detail Available]
    H[Authorization Summary and Detail\nRecords Successfully Retrieved]
    END([End: Return to Calling Process])

    B --> C
    C -->|Not Found / No More Records| D

rules.rule_name: Search Authorization Summary Records by Account ID
rules.rule_description: When retrieving authorization details, the system first searches for the Authorization Summary record using the Account ID as the primary search key before attempting to retrieve the associated detail record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Account ID to Search Authorization Summary Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Account ID and an Authorization Key are available in the current session context
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates an authorization record retrieval process using the Account ID to locate the corresponding Authorization Summary record in the database
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system searches the Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID as the lookup key, and the result determines whether processing continues to the Authorization Detail retrieval step

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Record Not Found – Mark End of Records
rules.rule_description: If no Authorization Summary record exists for the given Account ID, or there are no more records available, the system marks the retrieval status as end-of-records and stops further processing for this retrieval request.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark as End of Records
No Summary Available

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: No matching Authorization Summary record is found for the given Account ID, or the database indicates there are no more records to retrieve
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization retrieval status to 'End of Records' (AUTHS-EOF), and no further attempt is made to retrieve the Authorization Detail record; control is returned to the calling process

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Found – Proceed to Search Authorization Detail
rules.rule_description: Only when an Authorization Summary record is successfully found for the Account ID does the system proceed to retrieve the corresponding Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Authorization Key to Search Authorization Detail Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record has been successfully found for the given Account ID, and the authorization retrieval status is set to 'Not End of Records'
acceptance_criteria.When: The system proceeds to the next step of the retrieval process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system searches the Authorization Detail data store using the Authorization Key as the lookup key, scoped within the parent Authorization Summary record, to retrieve the specific authorization transaction details

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Record Not Found – Mark End of Records
rules.rule_description: If no Authorization Detail record matching the Authorization Key is found within the parent Authorization Summary, or there are no more detail records available, the system marks the retrieval status as end-of-records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark as End of Records
No Detail Available

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record was found and the system has searched for the Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key
acceptance_criteria.When: No matching Authorization Detail record is found for the given Authorization Key within the parent summary record, or the database indicates there are no more detail records
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization retrieval status to 'End of Records' (AUTHS-EOF), and control is returned to the calling process with no authorization detail data populated

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary and Detail Records Successfully Retrieved
rules.rule_description: When both the Authorization Summary and Authorization Detail records are successfully found, the system marks the retrieval as successful and makes the full authorization data available for display and processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Authorization Summary and Detail Records Successfully Retrieved

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched for both the Authorization Summary record by Account ID and the Authorization Detail record by Authorization Key
acceptance_criteria.When: Both the Authorization Summary record and the Authorization Detail record are found successfully in the database
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization retrieval status to 'Not End of Records' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) for both retrievals, the complete Authorization Detail data (including card number, authorization date, time, approved amount, response code, merchant information, fraud status, and all other authorization attributes) is loaded into the working data area, and control is returned to the calling process for further processing

rules.rule_name: Sequential Two-Step Authorization Record Retrieval Dependency
rules.rule_description: The retrieval of Authorization Detail records is strictly dependent on the prior successful retrieval of the Authorization Summary record. The system enforces a mandatory two-step sequential lookup: Summary first, then Detail only if Summary is found.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Authorization Summary and Detail Records Successfully Retrieved

acceptance_criteria.Given: A request has been made to retrieve authorization information for a specific Account ID and Authorization Key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the authorization record retrieval process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must first successfully locate the Authorization Summary record using the Account ID before it attempts to retrieve the Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key; if the Authorization Summary is not found, the Authorization Detail retrieval is skipped entirely and the process ends with an end-of-records status

sub_functionalities.title: Use Account ID to Search Authorization Summary Records

rules.rule_name: Search Authorization Summary Records Using Account ID
rules.rule_description: When a user requests to view authorization details, the system must search the Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID to locate the parent summary record before retrieving any authorization detail records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Search Authorization Summary Records
Using Account ID as search key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Account ID is available in the current session and an Authorization Key (selected authorization) has been identified for retrieval
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates a search for the Authorization Summary record using the Account ID as the primary search key against the Authorization Summary data store (PAUTSUM0)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Authorization Summary record matching the provided Account ID and proceeds to evaluate whether the record was found, not found, or the end of available records has been reached

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Record Successfully Found
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary record is successfully located using the Account ID, the system marks the record set as active (not at end) and proceeds to retrieve the corresponding Authorization Detail record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Authorization Summary Record Found
Proceed to retrieve
Authorization Detail

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has performed a search of the Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID as the search key
acceptance_criteria.When: The search returns a successful result indicating the Authorization Summary record exists for the given Account ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization record set status as 'Not End of Records' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) and proceeds to retrieve the Authorization Detail record associated with the selected Authorization Key

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Record Not Found or End of Database Reached
rules.rule_description: When the search for an Authorization Summary record using the Account ID yields no matching record or the end of the data store is reached, the system marks the record set as exhausted and stops any further authorization detail retrieval processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
No Authorization Summary Record Found
Mark as End of Records
Stop further processing

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has performed a search of the Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID as the search key
acceptance_criteria.When: The search result indicates either that no Authorization Summary record exists for the given Account ID (record not found) OR the end of the Authorization Summary data store has been reached
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the authorization record set status as 'End of Records' (AUTHS-EOF) and stops all further authorization detail retrieval processing for this request, returning no authorization details to the screen

sub_functionalities.title: Use Authorization Key to Search Authorization Detail Records
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Search Authorization Detail])
    B[Use Authorization Key\nto search for matching\nDetail Record in PAUTDTL1\nunder located Summary]
    C{Detail Record\nSearch Result}
    D[Detail Record Found\nSuccessfully\nSet Status: Not End of File]
    E[Detail Record\nNot Found\nor End of Database\nSet Status: End of File]
    F[Display Error Message\nto User]
    G([End: Return to\nCalling Process])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C -->|Record Found| D
    C -->|Record Not Found /\nEnd of Database| E
    C -->|Unexpected\nCondition| F

rules.rule_name: Prerequisite Check Before Searching Authorization Detail Record
rules.rule_description: The system must only attempt to retrieve an Authorization Detail record if the parent Authorization Summary record was successfully located. This ensures that detail record searches are always performed within the context of a valid summary.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Authorization Key to search for matching Detail Record in PAUTDTL1 under located Summary

acceptance_criteria.Given: An Authorization Summary record search has been performed for a given Account ID, and the result of that search is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is about to search for the Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to search for the Authorization Detail record ONLY IF the Authorization Summary record was found (status is Not End of File); if the summary was not found (status is End of File), the detail record search is skipped entirely

rules.rule_name: Search Authorization Detail Record Using Authorization Key
rules.rule_description: When a valid Authorization Summary has been located, the system uses the Authorization Key to search for the specific Authorization Detail record within the scope of that summary. The Authorization Key is the unique identifier used to match the correct detail record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Authorization Key to search for matching Detail Record in PAUTDTL1 under located Summary

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Authorization Summary record has been located for the given Account ID, and an Authorization Key (selected pending authorization) is available in the current session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches for the Authorization Detail record within the Authorization Detail data store (PAUTDTL1) under the located summary
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the Authorization Detail record whose Authorization Key matches the selected pending authorization key (PAUT9CTS = PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY), and the full authorization detail data is loaded into the working area (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Record Found Successfully
rules.rule_description: When the system successfully locates the Authorization Detail record matching the Authorization Key, it marks the retrieval status as active (Not End of File), allowing subsequent processing to use the retrieved detail data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Detail Record Found Successfully
Set Status: Not End of File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched for an Authorization Detail record in PAUTDTL1 using the Authorization Key under the located Authorization Summary
acceptance_criteria.When: The Authorization Detail record is found successfully (search returns a normal/OK status)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization retrieval status to 'Not End of File', indicating that a valid Authorization Detail record has been retrieved and is available for display and processing

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Record Not Found or No More Records
rules.rule_description: When the system cannot locate an Authorization Detail record matching the Authorization Key — either because no matching record exists or because the end of available records has been reached — it marks the retrieval status as End of File, signaling that no detail data is available for display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Detail Record Not Found or End of Database
Set Status: End of File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched for an Authorization Detail record in PAUTDTL1 using the Authorization Key under the located Authorization Summary
acceptance_criteria.When: The Authorization Detail record is not found (no matching record exists for the given Authorization Key) OR the end of the authorization detail data has been reached
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization retrieval status to 'End of File', indicating that no Authorization Detail record is available for the given Authorization Key, and no detail data is populated for display

rules.rule_name: Unexpected Error During Authorization Detail Record Search
rules.rule_description: When an unexpected condition occurs while searching for the Authorization Detail record — any condition other than a successful retrieval, record not found, or end of database — the system treats this as a system error and immediately notifies the user with an error message on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message to User

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched for an Authorization Detail record in PAUTDTL1 using the Authorization Key under the located Authorization Summary
acceptance_criteria.When: The search returns an unexpected result that is neither a successful retrieval, a record-not-found condition, nor an end-of-database condition
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error indicator to 'Y', composes an error message stating 'System error while reading Auth Details' along with the specific error status code returned, and immediately displays this error message to the user on the Authorization Detail View screen

key_functionalities.title: Next Authorization Record Retrieval
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD

    B[Set Current Account ID\nand Authorization Key\nfrom Communication Area]

    E{Next Record\nFound?}
    F[11: End of Records Detected\nDisplay Message:\n'Already at the last Authorization...']

    I[Refresh Screen Display\nwith Next Authorization\nDetails]

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D

    F --> K

    I --> J

rules.rule_name: Set Navigation Context from Current Session for PF8 Forward Navigation
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 to navigate forward, the system retrieves the current Account ID and the currently selected Authorization Key from the active session to establish the navigation starting point.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Current Account ID and Authorization Key from Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing an authorization detail screen and the session contains a valid Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and a currently selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 to navigate to the next authorization record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the working Account ID (WS-ACCT-ID) to the session Account ID and sets the working Authorization Key (WS-AUTH-KEY) to the currently selected Authorization Key from the session, establishing the current position for forward navigation

rules.rule_name: Position Database Cursor at Current Authorization Record Before Forward Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before retrieving the next authorization, the system must first read the current authorization's summary and detail records to correctly position the database cursor, enabling sequential forward navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Current Authorization Summary and Detail Records to Position in Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The working Account ID (WS-ACCT-ID) and Authorization Key (WS-AUTH-KEY) have been set from the session data
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates forward navigation by pressing PF8
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system first retrieves the Authorization Summary record for the given Account ID, and then retrieves the specific Authorization Detail record matching the current Authorization Key, positioning the database cursor at the current record so that the next sequential record can be retrieved

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Next Sequential Authorization Detail Record
rules.rule_description: After positioning at the current authorization record, the system retrieves the next sequential authorization detail record for the same account without specifying a key, relying on the current database cursor position.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Next Sequential Authorization Detail Record from Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The database cursor is positioned at the current authorization detail record for the account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the next sequential authorization detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next authorization detail record in sequence; if a record is found, the authorization status is set to 'records available' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF); if no further records exist (end of data or segment not found), the authorization status is set to 'end of records' (AUTHS-EOF)

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Authorization Records and Display Boundary Message
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate past the last authorization record, the system detects the end-of-records condition and informs the user that no further authorizations are available, while preserving the current screen content.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 11: End of Records Detected - Display Message: 'Already at the last Authorization...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the last authorization detail record for the account and presses PF8 to navigate forward
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to read the next sequential authorization record and the end-of-records condition (AUTHS-EOF) is detected
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the screen refresh mode to 'no erase' (SEND-ERASE-NO) so the current screen content is preserved, and sets the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' to be displayed to the user

rules.rule_name: Update Session with Next Authorization Key Upon Successful Navigation
rules.rule_description: When the next authorization record is successfully retrieved, the system updates the session's selected authorization key with the key from the newly retrieved record, making it the new current authorization.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Update Selected Authorization Key with Next Record's Authorization Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The next sequential authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) and the record contains a valid Authorization Key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms that a next authorization record exists
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system updates the session's selected authorization key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED) with the Authorization Key from the newly retrieved record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY), making the next authorization the currently selected one

rules.rule_name: Populate Screen Fields with Next Authorization Detail Information
rules.rule_description: After successfully navigating to the next authorization, the system populates all authorization detail fields on the screen with the data from the newly retrieved authorization record, including card, transaction, merchant, and fraud information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Screen with Next Authorization Detail Information

acceptance_criteria.Given: The next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the session's selected authorization key has been updated, and no error flag is active (ERR-FLG-OFF)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the following fields from the next authorization record: Card Number, Authorization Date (formatted as MM/DD/YY), Authorization Time (formatted as HH:MM:SS), Approved Amount, Response Status ('A' for Approved in green if response code is '00', or 'D' for Declined in red for any other code), Decline Reason (looked up from the Decline Reason Table by reason code — showing code and description, or '9999-ERROR' if not found), Processing Code, POS Entry Mode, Message Source, Merchant Category Code, Card Expiry Date (formatted as MM/YY with '/' separator), Authorization Type, Transaction ID, Match Status, Fraud Status (fraud flag + '-' + fraud report date if fraud confirmed or removed, otherwise '-'), Merchant Name, Merchant ID, Merchant City, Merchant State, and Merchant ZIP

rules.rule_name: Refresh Screen Display After PF8 Navigation with Conditional Erase
rules.rule_description: After PF8 navigation processing is complete, the system refreshes the authorization detail screen. The screen is fully erased and redrawn when a next record is found, but is refreshed without erasing when the end-of-records boundary is reached, preserving the last visible authorization data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Refresh Screen Display with Next Authorization Details

acceptance_criteria.Given: PF8 navigation processing has completed, the screen header has been populated with the current system date and time, and the error message area has been updated with either a navigation message or an end-of-records message
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the authorization detail screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the screen erase flag is set to 'YES' (SEND-ERASE-YES) — which is the case when a next record was found — the screen is fully erased and redrawn with the next authorization's details; if the screen erase flag is set to 'NO' (SEND-ERASE-NO) — which is the case when end-of-records was detected — the screen is refreshed without erasing, preserving the current authorization data and displaying the message 'Already at the last Authorization...'

key_functionalities.title: End of Authorization Records Detection
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

rules.rule_name: Trigger Next Authorization Navigation via PF8
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF8 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system initiates the process to navigate to the next pending authorization record for the same account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: PF8 - Navigate to Next Authorization

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Authorization Detail screen with a valid Account ID and a currently selected Authorization record
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF8 to navigate to the next authorization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the current Account ID and the currently selected Authorization Key as the lookup criteria and begins the process of reading the current and next authorization records

rules.rule_name: Read Current Authorization Record Before Navigation
rules.rule_description: Before attempting to retrieve the next authorization record, the system must first re-read the current authorization record to establish the correct database position for sequential navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Current Authorization Record from Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 and the system has the current Account ID and Authorization Key available in the session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates the next-authorization navigation process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads the Authorization Summary record for the current Account ID and then reads the Authorization Detail record matching the current Authorization Key, establishing the correct position in the authorization record set before attempting to retrieve the next record

rules.rule_name: Attempt to Read Next Sequential Authorization Record
rules.rule_description: After positioning on the current authorization record, the system attempts to retrieve the next authorization detail record in sequence for the same account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Attempt to Read Next Authorization Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully positioned on the current authorization record in the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to read the next authorization detail record sequentially
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next Authorization Detail record in sequence; if a record is found, the end-of-records flag is set to NOT-EOF; if no further records exist (segment not found or end of database), the end-of-records flag is set to EOF

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Authorization Records
rules.rule_description: After attempting to read the next authorization record, the system evaluates whether any further authorization records exist for the account to determine the appropriate screen behavior.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Next Record Found?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read the next authorization record after the currently displayed one
acceptance_criteria.When: The result of the next-record read is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the read returns a 'segment not found' or 'end of database' status, the system sets the end-of-records flag (AUTHS-EOF) to TRUE, indicating no more authorization records are available; if the read is successful, the end-of-records flag is set to NOT-EOF

rules.rule_name: Set Partial Screen Refresh When at Last Authorization
rules.rule_description: When the user has reached the last authorization record and no further records exist, the screen must be refreshed without fully erasing the current display, preserving the currently visible authorization details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Screen Partial Refresh No Full Erase

acceptance_criteria.Given: The end-of-records flag (AUTHS-EOF) is TRUE, indicating the user is already viewing the last authorization record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to refresh the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the screen send mode to 'No Erase' (SEND-ERASE-NO), so the current authorization details remain visible on screen and are not cleared during the screen refresh

rules.rule_name: Display End-of-Records Message for Last Authorization
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to navigate past the last available authorization record, the system must inform the user that no further authorization records exist.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Message: 'Already at the last Authorization...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The end-of-records flag is TRUE, indicating no more authorization records exist beyond the currently displayed one, and the screen is set to partial refresh mode
acceptance_criteria.When: The Authorization Detail screen is sent to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' in the message area of the screen, while keeping the current authorization details visible

rules.rule_name: Update Selected Authorization Key to Next Record
rules.rule_description: When a next authorization record is successfully found, the system updates the session's selected authorization identifier to reflect the newly retrieved record, so subsequent actions operate on the correct authorization.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Update Selected Authorization to Next Record Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The end-of-records flag is NOT-EOF, meaning a next authorization record was successfully retrieved
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the successful next-record retrieval
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system updates the session's currently selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED) with the Authorization Key from the newly retrieved next authorization record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY)

rules.rule_name: Populate Screen with Next Authorization Details
rules.rule_description: After successfully navigating to the next authorization record, the system populates all authorization detail fields on the screen with the data from the newly selected authorization record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Screen with Next Authorization Details

acceptance_criteria.Given: The session's selected Authorization Key has been updated to the next authorization record and no error flag is set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays all fields of the next authorization record including: Card Number, Authorization Date (formatted as MM/DD/YY), Authorization Time (formatted as HH:MM:SS), Approved Amount, Response Status ('A' in green if response code is '00', 'D' in red otherwise), Decline Reason (looked up from the Decline Reason table by reason code - showing 'code-description' if found, or '9999-ERROR' if not found), Processing Code, POS Entry Mode, Message Source, Merchant Category Code, Card Expiry Date (formatted as MM/YY), Authorization Type, Transaction ID, Match Status, Fraud Status (showing fraud flag + '-' + fraud report date if fraud confirmed or removed, otherwise '-'), Merchant Name, Merchant ID, Merchant City, Merchant State, and Merchant ZIP

key_functionalities.title: Authorization Detail Display Population
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

    B{Error Flag\nOff?}
    C([End: Skip Population\nDue to Error])
