rules.rule_name: Skip Authorization Detail Population When Error Exists
rules.rule_description: The system must only populate authorization detail screen fields when there are no prior processing errors. If an error condition exists, all field population is bypassed entirely.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Error Flag Off?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered
acceptance_criteria.When: An error flag is active (error condition exists from a prior processing step such as missing account ID or missing authorization selection)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system skips all authorization detail field population and no screen fields are updated with authorization data

rules.rule_name: Display Card Number on Authorization Detail Screen
rules.rule_description: When no error exists, the credit card number associated with the pending authorization record is displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card number from the pending authorization record (PA-CARD-NUM) is displayed in the Card Number field (CARDNUMO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Authorization Origination Date as MM/DD/YY
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination date stored in the system in YYMMDD format must be rearranged and displayed in MM/DD/YY format on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format & Display Authorization Date
Rearrange from YYMMDD
to MM/DD/YY format

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the authorization origination date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) stored in YYMMDD format where positions 1-2 are YY, positions 3-4 are MM, and positions 5-6 are DD
acceptance_criteria.Then: The date is rearranged so that MM is placed first, DD second, and YY third, forming the MM/DD/YY display format, and the reformatted date is displayed in the Authorization Date field (AUTHDTO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Authorization Origination Time as HH:MM:SS
rules.rule_description: The authorization origination time stored in the system in HHMMSS format must be formatted with colon separators and displayed as HH:MM:SS on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format & Display Authorization Time
Insert colon separators
between HH MM SS

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the authorization origination time (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) where positions 1-2 are hours (HH), positions 3-4 are minutes (MM), and positions 5-6 are seconds (SS)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The hours are placed in positions 1-2 of the display time field, minutes in positions 4-5, and seconds in positions 7-8 (with colon separators implicitly at positions 3 and 6), and the formatted time is displayed in the Authorization Time field (AUTHTMO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Approved Amount on Authorization Detail Screen
rules.rule_description: The approved dollar amount from the pending authorization record is formatted and displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Approved Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The approved amount from the pending authorization record (PA-APPROVED-AMT) is moved to the working storage amount field (WS-AUTH-AMT) and then displayed in the Approved Amount field (AUTHAMTO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Response as Approved with Green Color When Response Code is 00
rules.rule_description: When the authorization response code is '00', the authorization is considered approved and must be displayed with the letter 'A' highlighted in green color to visually indicate approval.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Response
Code = '00'?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) equals '00'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The response status field (AUTHRSPO) on the screen is set to 'A' (Approved) and the field color attribute (AUTHRSPC) is set to GREEN

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Response as Declined with Red Color When Response Code is Not 00
rules.rule_description: When the authorization response code is anything other than '00', the authorization is considered declined and must be displayed with the letter 'D' highlighted in red color to visually indicate the decline.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display 'D' for Declined
in RED color

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) is any value other than '00'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The response status field (AUTHRSPO) on the screen is set to 'D' (Declined) and the field color attribute (AUTHRSPC) is set to RED

rules.rule_name: Look Up Decline Reason Description from Decline Reason Table
rules.rule_description: After determining the authorization response status, the system performs a binary search of the Decline Reason Table using the authorization response reason code to find the corresponding human-readable description.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Search Decline Reason Table
for Response Reason Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered, no error flag is active, and the authorization response status (Approved or Declined) has been determined
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the Decline Reason Table (WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB) using the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) as the search key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system evaluates whether a matching decline reason code (DECL-CODE) exists in the table and proceeds to display either the matched description or a default error value

rules.rule_name: Display Matched Decline Reason Code and Description When Found in Table
rules.rule_description: When the authorization response reason code is found in the Decline Reason Table, the system displays the reason code followed by a dash separator and the corresponding description.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Reason Code
Found in Table?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the Decline Reason Table for the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON)
acceptance_criteria.When: A matching decline reason code (DECL-CODE) is found in the Decline Reason Table at index WS-DECL-RSN-IDX
acceptance_criteria.Then: The decline reason display field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with: the response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) in positions 1-4, a dash '-' in position 5, and the matched decline description (DECL-DESC at WS-DECL-RSN-IDX) starting at position 6 onwards

rules.rule_name: Display Default Error Code 9999-ERROR When Decline Reason Not Found in Table
rules.rule_description: When the authorization response reason code cannot be found in the Decline Reason Table, the system displays a default error indicator '9999-ERROR' to signal an unrecognized decline reason.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display '9999-ERROR'
as Default Decline Reason

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has searched the Decline Reason Table for the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON)
acceptance_criteria.When: No matching decline reason code is found in the Decline Reason Table (AT END condition)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The decline reason display field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with: '9999' in positions 1-4, a dash '-' in position 5, and 'ERROR' starting at position 6 onwards, resulting in the display value '9999-ERROR'

rules.rule_name: Display Processing Code, POS Entry Mode, Message Source, and Merchant Category Code
rules.rule_description: The authorization transaction processing code, point-of-sale entry mode, message source, and merchant category code are displayed on the Authorization Detail screen to provide full transaction context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Processing Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail fields after determining the decline reason
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following fields are displayed on screen: Processing Code (PA-PROCESSING-CODE) in AUTHCDO, POS Entry Mode (PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE) in POSEMDO, Message Source (PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE) in AUTHSRCO, and Merchant Category Code (PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE) in MCCCDO

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Card Expiry Date with Slash Separator as MM/YY
rules.rule_description: The card expiry date stored in the system in MMYY format must be formatted with a slash separator and displayed as MM/YY on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format & Display Card Expiry Date
Insert slash separator
between Month and Year

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the card expiry date (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE) where positions 1-2 are the month (MM) and positions 3-4 are the year (YY)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The card expiry display field (CRDEXPO) is populated with: the month (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE positions 1-2) in positions 1-2, a slash '/' in position 3, and the year (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE positions 3-4) in positions 4-5, resulting in MM/YY format

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Type, Transaction ID, and Match Status
rules.rule_description: The authorization type, unique transaction identifier, and authorization match status are displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Authorization Type

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail fields after displaying the card expiry date
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following fields are displayed on screen: Authorization Type (PA-AUTH-TYPE) in AUTHTYPO, Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID) in TRNIDO, and Match Status (PA-MATCH-STATUS) in AUTHMTCO

rules.rule_name: Display Fraud Flag and Fraud Report Date When Authorization Has Fraud History
rules.rule_description: When an authorization has been either confirmed as fraudulent or had its fraud flag removed (indicating a fraud history exists), the fraud indicator and the date the fraud was reported are displayed on screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fraud Status is
Confirmed or Removed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization fraud status is either PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED (fraud has been confirmed) OR PA-FRAUD-REMOVED (fraud flag was previously set and then removed)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud status display field (AUTHFRDO) is populated with: the fraud flag indicator (PA-AUTH-FRAUD) in position 1, a dash '-' in position 2, and the fraud report date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE) starting at position 3 onwards

rules.rule_name: Display Dash for Fraud Status When Authorization Has No Fraud History
rules.rule_description: When an authorization has no fraud history (neither confirmed as fraud nor had fraud removed), the fraud status field displays only a dash to indicate no fraud activity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Dash '-'
for Fraud Status

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The authorization fraud status is neither PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED nor PA-FRAUD-REMOVED (no fraud history exists for this authorization)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud status display field (AUTHFRDO) is set to a single dash '-' indicating no fraud activity associated with this authorization

rules.rule_name: Display Complete Merchant Information on Authorization Detail Screen
rules.rule_description: The complete merchant information including name, identifier, city, state, and ZIP code from the pending authorization record is displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Merchant Name

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the final set of authorization detail fields after displaying the fraud status
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following merchant fields are displayed on screen: Merchant Name (PA-MERCHANT-NAME) in MERNAMEO, Merchant ID (PA-MERCHANT-ID) in MERIDO, Merchant City (PA-MERCHANT-CITY) in MERCITYO, Merchant State (PA-MERCHANT-STATE) in MERSTO, and Merchant ZIP Code (PA-MERCHANT-ZIP) in MERZIPO

rules.rule_name: Identify Approved Authorization by Response Code
rules.rule_description: When an authorization response code of '00' is received, the system identifies the transaction as approved and sets the display indicator to 'A' with a green color highlight to visually distinguish approved authorizations on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Response Code = '00'? → Set Indicator to 'A' for Approved → Apply GREEN Color Highlight

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been retrieved and the Authorization Response Code field (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) is available for evaluation
acceptance_criteria.When: The Authorization Response Code equals '00'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Status Indicator (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'A' representing Approved, and the display color attribute (AUTHRSPC) is set to GREEN so the status is visually highlighted in green on the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Identify Declined Authorization by Response Code
rules.rule_description: When an authorization response code other than '00' is received, the system identifies the transaction as declined and sets the display indicator to 'D' with a red color highlight to visually distinguish declined authorizations on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Response Code = '00'? → No - Any Other Code → Set Indicator to 'D' for Declined → Apply RED Color Highlight

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been retrieved and the Authorization Response Code field (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) is available for evaluation
acceptance_criteria.When: The Authorization Response Code is any value other than '00'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Status Indicator (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'D' representing Declined, and the display color attribute (AUTHRSPC) is set to RED so the status is visually highlighted in red on the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Display Authorization Approval Status with Color Coding on Screen
rules.rule_description: The authorization approval or decline status indicator along with its corresponding color coding (green for approved, red for declined) is rendered on the Authorization Detail screen to provide immediate visual feedback to the user about the outcome of the authorization.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Authorization Status Indicator on Screen with Color Coding

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Response Code has been evaluated and the Authorization Status Indicator (AUTHRSPO) has been set to either 'A' (Approved) or 'D' (Declined), and the corresponding color attribute (AUTHRSPC) has been set to either GREEN or RED
acceptance_criteria.When: The Authorization Detail screen (COPAU1A in mapset COPAU01) is sent to the user via the SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Status Indicator field (AUTHRSPO) displays 'A' in GREEN for approved authorizations or 'D' in RED for declined authorizations, providing clear color-coded visual feedback on the screen

key_functionalities.title: Decline Reason Code Lookup
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

rules.rule_name: Search Decline Reason Table for Authorization Response Reason Code
rules.rule_description: When displaying authorization details, the system searches a predefined Decline Reason Table using the authorization response reason code to retrieve the corresponding decline description for display on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Search Decline Reason Table for Matching Reason Code

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and the Authorization Detail screen is being populated, and the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) is available from the authorization record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system searches the Decline Reason Table (WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB) using the authorization response reason code as the search key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system either finds a matching decline reason entry and displays the code and description, or finds no match and displays a default error indicator in the Decline Reason field (AUTHRSNO) on the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Display Matched Decline Reason Code and Description
rules.rule_description: When a matching entry is found in the Decline Reason Table for the authorization response reason code, the system formats and displays the reason code followed by a dash separator and its corresponding description on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Reason Code followed by dash and its Description e.g. '0051-INSUFFICIENT FUNDS'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is searching the Decline Reason Table and the authorization response reason code from the authorization record (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) matches a decline code entry (DECL-CODE) in the Decline Reason Table
acceptance_criteria.When: A matching decline reason code is found in the Decline Reason Table
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Detail screen Decline Reason field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with: the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) in positions 1-4, a dash '-' separator in position 5, and the matching decline description (DECL-DESC) starting from position 6 onwards — resulting in a display format such as '0051-INSUFFICIENT FUNDS'

rules.rule_name: Display Default Error Indicator When Decline Reason Code Not Found
rules.rule_description: When the authorization response reason code does not match any entry in the Decline Reason Table, the system displays a default error indicator '9999-ERROR' in the Decline Reason field to signal that the reason code is unrecognized.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Default Error '9999-ERROR' Reason Code Not Found

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is searching the Decline Reason Table and the authorization response reason code from the authorization record (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) does not match any decline code entry (DECL-CODE) in the entire Decline Reason Table
acceptance_criteria.When: The search reaches the end of the Decline Reason Table without finding a matching entry
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Detail screen Decline Reason field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with: the literal value '9999' in positions 1-4, a dash '-' separator in position 5, and the literal text 'ERROR' starting from position 6 onwards — resulting in a display of '9999-ERROR' to indicate an unrecognized decline reason code

key_functionalities.title: Fraud Status Display

rules.rule_name: Evaluate Fraud Activity Status for Authorization
rules.rule_description: Determines whether an authorization record has any fraud activity history — either currently confirmed as fraud or previously flagged and subsequently removed — to decide which fraud status display format to apply on the Authorization Detail screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Authorization Confirmed as Fraud OR Fraud Removed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and is being prepared for display on the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the fraud status of the authorization record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the authorization is marked as 'Fraud Confirmed' OR marked as 'Fraud Removed', the system proceeds to display the full fraud activity details (fraud flag, separator, and fraud report date); otherwise, the system proceeds to display a dash indicating no fraud activity

rules.rule_name: Display Full Fraud Activity Details When Fraud Is Present
rules.rule_description: When an authorization has been confirmed as fraud or has had a fraud flag removed, the system displays the complete fraud activity information: the fraud flag indicator from the authorization record, a dash as a separator, and the date on which the fraud was reported.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Fraud Flag from Authorization Record / Display Dash Separator / Display Fraud Report Date

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record is being prepared for display on the Authorization Detail screen, AND the authorization is either currently confirmed as fraud OR has previously had its fraud flag removed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the fraud status field on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud status field displays: (1) the fraud flag indicator character from the authorization record in the first position, followed by (2) a dash '-' separator in the second position, followed by (3) the fraud report date from the authorization record starting at the third position — for example: 'Y-20240115'

rules.rule_name: Display Dash When No Fraud Activity Exists
rules.rule_description: When an authorization has no fraud history — meaning it has never been confirmed as fraud and has never had a fraud flag removed — the system displays only a dash in the fraud status field to indicate the absence of any fraud activity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Dash Indicating No Fraud Activity

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record is being prepared for display on the Authorization Detail screen, AND the authorization is NOT confirmed as fraud AND has NOT had a fraud flag removed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the fraud status field on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fraud status field displays only a single dash '-' indicating that there is no fraud activity associated with this authorization

rules.rule_name: Trigger Fraud Toggle Action on PF5 Key Press
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF5 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system initiates the fraud mark/unmark process for the currently displayed authorization record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Start: PF5 Key Pressed
Mark/Unmark Fraud Requested

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is viewing the Authorization Detail screen with a specific authorization record displayed, identified by the current Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and the selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF5 function key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system initiates the fraud toggle process (MARK-AUTH-FRAUD) using the current Account ID and selected Authorization Key, then refreshes and sends the Authorization Detail screen with updated information

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Authorization Record Prior to Fraud Action
rules.rule_description: Before any fraud status change can be made, the system must retrieve the current authorization record from the database using the Account ID and Authorization Key to ensure the latest fraud status is evaluated.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Retrieve Current Authorization
Record from Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF5 to toggle fraud status, and the session contains a valid Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and a selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED)
acceptance_criteria.When: The fraud toggle process begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads the current authorization record from the Pending Authorization database using the Account ID and Authorization Key, loading the full authorization details including the current fraud status into the working area (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) before any fraud status evaluation occurs

rules.rule_name: Fraud Confirmation Toggle - Remove Fraud When Already Confirmed
rules.rule_description: If the authorization record is currently marked as confirmed fraud, pressing PF5 reverses the fraud status by removing the fraud confirmation flag, effectively un-flagging the transaction as fraudulent.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Is Authorization
Already Confirmed
as Fraud? → Yes - Currently Fraud → Set Status to: FRAUD REMOVED

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization record has been retrieved from the database and its current fraud status is 'Confirmed Fraud' (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The fraud toggle process evaluates the current fraud status
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization fraud status to 'Fraud Removed' (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED = TRUE) and sets the action indicator to 'Remove Fraud' (WS-REMOVE-FRAUD = TRUE), preparing the record for the fraud removal update

rules.rule_name: Fraud Confirmation Toggle - Mark as Fraud When Not Currently Flagged
rules.rule_description: If the authorization record is not currently marked as fraud, pressing PF5 confirms the authorization as fraudulent by setting the fraud confirmation flag.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Is Authorization
Already Confirmed
as Fraud? → No - Not Currently Fraud → Set Status to: FRAUD CONFIRMED

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization record has been retrieved from the database and its current fraud status is NOT 'Confirmed Fraud' (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is FALSE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The fraud toggle process evaluates the current fraud status
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization fraud status to 'Fraud Confirmed' (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED = TRUE) and sets the action indicator to 'Report Fraud' (WS-REPORT-FRAUD = TRUE), preparing the record for the fraud confirmation update

rules.rule_name: Invoke External Fraud Processing Program with Authorization and Customer Data
rules.rule_description: After determining the new fraud status, the system must call the external Fraud Processing Program (COPAUS2C) passing the full authorization details along with the Account ID and Customer ID to process the fraud action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Pass Updated Authorization
to Fraud Processing Program
COPAUS2C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud status toggle has been determined (either FRAUD CONFIRMED or FRAUD REMOVED), the updated authorization detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) has been copied to the fraud data workspace (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD), and both the Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID → WS-FRD-ACCT-ID) and Customer ID (CDEMO-CUST-ID → WS-FRD-CUST-ID) have been populated in the fraud data communication area (WS-FRAUD-DATA)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system calls the external Fraud Processing Program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) via CICS LINK passing the fraud data communication area (WS-FRAUD-DATA)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The external Fraud Processing Program is invoked with the complete fraud data package containing the authorization details, Account ID, and Customer ID; the system then evaluates the response to determine whether to proceed with the database update or rollback

rules.rule_name: Handle Fraud Program Failure - Rollback All Changes
rules.rule_description: If the external Fraud Processing Program returns a non-successful response (system-level failure), all pending changes must be rolled back to preserve data integrity, and the error message returned by the fraud program is displayed to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fraud Program
Returned Success? → Failure → Rollback All Changes
Display Error Message
from Fraud Program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) has been called with the fraud data
acceptance_criteria.When: The CICS LINK call to the Fraud Processing Program returns a non-normal response (EIBRESP is not equal to DFHRESP(NORMAL)), OR the fraud program returns a non-successful update indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is FALSE) along with an error message (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs a full rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) of all pending changes; if the fraud program returned an error message (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG), that message is displayed to the user on the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Persist Fraud Status Update to Database After Successful Fraud Program Response
rules.rule_description: When the external Fraud Processing Program confirms a successful fraud action, the system saves the updated authorization record with the new fraud status back to the Pending Authorization database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fraud Program
Returned Success? → Success → Save Updated Fraud Status
Back to Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) has returned a normal CICS response (EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)) and has indicated a successful update (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system proceeds to update the authorization record in the database
acceptance_criteria.Then: The updated fraud data record (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD) is written back to the Pending Authorization Details segment (PAUTDTL1) in the database using a replace operation, overwriting the previous authorization detail record with the new fraud status information

rules.rule_name: Confirm Fraud Removal - Commit and Display Confirmation Message
rules.rule_description: When the database update succeeds and the action was to remove a fraud flag, the system commits the transaction and notifies the user that the fraud marking has been successfully removed from the authorization.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Database Update
Successful? → Success - Fraud Removed → Display Message: 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The database update of the authorization record has completed successfully (database status is OK) and the fraud action was to remove the fraud flag (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the database update
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system commits all changes via a CICS SYNCPOINT and displays the confirmation message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' to the user on the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Confirm Fraud Marking - Commit and Display Confirmation Message
rules.rule_description: When the database update succeeds and the action was to confirm an authorization as fraud, the system commits the transaction and notifies the user that the authorization has been successfully flagged as fraudulent.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Database Update
Successful? → Success - Fraud Marked → Display Message: 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The database update of the authorization record has completed successfully (database status is OK) and the fraud action was to confirm fraud (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is TRUE, meaning PA-FRAUD-REMOVED is FALSE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the database update
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system commits all changes via a CICS SYNCPOINT and displays the confirmation message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' to the user on the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Handle Database Update Failure - Rollback and Display System Error
rules.rule_description: If the database update of the fraud status fails for any reason, the system must rollback all changes to maintain data integrity and display a system error message to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Database Update
Successful? → Failure → Rollback All Changes
Display System Error Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to update the authorization record in the Pending Authorization Details database segment (PAUTDTL1) with the new fraud status
acceptance_criteria.When: The database update operation returns any status other than successful (database status is not OK)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs a full rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) of all pending changes, sets the error flag (WS-ERR-FLG = 'Y'), and displays a system error message indicating 'System error while FRAUD Tagging, ROLLBACK' along with the database error code on the Authorization Detail screen

key_functionalities.title: Fraud Processing Delegation
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Fraud Processing Delegation])
    B[Prepare Authorization Details\nCopy current authorization details\ninto fraud data package]
    C[Set Account ID\nAdd Account ID to\nfraud data package]
    D[Set Customer ID\nAdd Customer ID to\nfraud data package]
    E[Call Fraud Processing Program\nCOPAUS2C\nPass complete fraud data package]
    F{Fraud Program\nResponded\nSuccessfully?}
    G{Fraud Update\nSucceeded?}
    H[18: Proceed to\nFraud Update Success Handling\nUpdate authorization record\nand display success message]
    I[19: Proceed to\nFraud Update Failure Handling\nCapture error message\nfrom fraud program]
    J[19: Proceed to\nFraud Update Failure Handling\nFraud program did not respond,\ntrigger rollback]
    END([End: Fraud Processing Delegation])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F -->|Yes - Normal Response| G
    F -->|No - Abnormal Response| J

    G -->|No - Update Failed| I
    H --> END
    I --> END

rules.rule_name: Assemble Fraud Data Package with Authorization and Account Details
rules.rule_description: Before delegating fraud processing to the external fraud program, the system must assemble a complete fraud data package containing the full authorization details, the associated Account ID, and the Customer ID. All three components are mandatory for the fraud program to process the request.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Prepare Authorization Details
Copy current authorization details
into fraud data package / Set Account ID
Add Account ID to
fraud data package / Set Customer ID
Add Customer ID to
fraud data package

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud toggle action (mark or unmark) has been initiated for a pending authorization, and the current authorization details (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS), Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID), and Customer ID (CDEMO-CUST-ID) are available in the session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud data package prior to calling the external fraud processing program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the full current authorization details into the fraud data record (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD), sets the Account ID field (WS-FRD-ACCT-ID) to the session Account ID, and sets the Customer ID field (WS-FRD-CUST-ID) to the session Customer ID, forming a complete fraud data package (WS-FRAUD-DATA) ready for submission

rules.rule_name: Delegate Fraud Status Update to External Fraud Processing Program
rules.rule_description: The system must delegate the actual fraud status update operation to the dedicated external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C), passing the fully assembled fraud data package. This ensures fraud processing logic is centralized in a dedicated program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Call Fraud Processing Program
COPAUS2C
Pass complete fraud data package

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud data package (WS-FRAUD-DATA) has been fully assembled with authorization details, Account ID, and Customer ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The system invokes the external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) by passing the complete fraud data package as the communication area
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system calls the fraud processing program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD / COPAUS2C) via a synchronous program link, passing the fraud data package (WS-FRAUD-DATA), and waits for the program to complete before evaluating the response

rules.rule_name: Evaluate Fraud Program Response to Determine Processing Path
rules.rule_description: After the external fraud processing program completes, the system must evaluate whether the program responded with a normal (successful) completion status. An abnormal response indicates a system-level failure and must be handled differently from a business-level update failure.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fraud Program
Responded
Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has been called with the fraud data package
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the response status from the fraud processing program
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the fraud program returned a normal response, the system proceeds to evaluate whether the fraud data update itself was successful; if the fraud program returned an abnormal (non-normal) response, the system treats this as a system-level failure and proceeds to fraud update failure handling with a rollback

rules.rule_name: Evaluate Fraud Data Update Outcome After Successful Program Response
rules.rule_description: When the external fraud program responds normally, the system must further evaluate whether the fraud data update operation within that program was actually completed successfully. A normal program response does not guarantee the business update succeeded.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Fraud Update
Succeeded?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has responded with a normal completion status
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks the fraud update success indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS) returned by the fraud program within the fraud data package
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the fraud update success indicator is set to true (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS), the system proceeds to update the authorization record in the database and display a success message; if the fraud update success indicator is not set, the system proceeds to fraud update failure handling

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Authorization Record Update on Successful Fraud Processing
rules.rule_description: When both the fraud program response is normal and the fraud update is confirmed as successful, the system must proceed to update the authorization record in the database to reflect the new fraud status and display an appropriate confirmation message to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18: Proceed to
Fraud Update Success Handling
Update authorization record
and display success message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has responded normally and the fraud update success indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS) is set to true
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines that fraud processing completed successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to execute the authorization record update process (UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS), which writes the updated fraud status back to the authorization database and displays either 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' or 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' depending on the fraud action taken

rules.rule_name: Capture Fraud Program Error Message and Rollback on Update Failure
rules.rule_description: When the external fraud program responds normally but reports that the fraud data update was unsuccessful, the system must capture the error message provided by the fraud program, display it to the user, and rollback all pending changes to maintain data integrity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19: Proceed to
Fraud Update Failure Handling
Capture error message
from fraud program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has responded with a normal completion status, but the fraud update success indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS) is not set, indicating a business-level update failure
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the fraud update failure condition
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the action message returned by the fraud program (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG) and sets it as the screen message (WS-MESSAGE) to be displayed to the user, then executes a rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) to reverse all pending database changes, ensuring no partial fraud updates are committed

rules.rule_name: Rollback All Changes on Abnormal Fraud Program Response
rules.rule_description: When the external fraud processing program fails to respond normally (system-level failure), the system must immediately rollback all pending changes to ensure data integrity, as the outcome of the fraud processing is unknown.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19: Proceed to
Fraud Update Failure Handling
Fraud program did not respond,
trigger rollback

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has been called with the fraud data package
acceptance_criteria.When: The fraud program returns an abnormal (non-normal) response status, indicating a system-level failure during fraud processing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system executes a rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) to reverse all pending database changes made during the current fraud toggle operation, ensuring the authorization record remains in its original state prior to the fraud action attempt

sub_functionalities.title: Prepare Authorization Details
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Prepare Authorization\nDetails for Fraud Processing])
    B[Retrieve current authorization\nrecord from database using\nAccount ID and Authorization Key]
    C{Is Authorization\nAlready Confirmed\nas Fraud?}
    D[Set Status Flag:\nFRAUD REMOVED\nMark for Fraud Removal]
    E[Set Status Flag:\nFRAUD CONFIRMED\nMark for Fraud Reporting]
    F[Copy updated authorization\ndetails into\nFraud Data Package]
    G[Assign Account ID\nto Fraud Data Package]
    H[Assign Customer ID\nto Fraud Data Package]

    A --> B

    C -->|No - Not Yet Fraud| E
    D --> F
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G --> H
    H --> I

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Authorization Record for Fraud Processing
rules.rule_description: Before any fraud status change can be made, the system must retrieve the current authorization record from the database using the Account ID and the selected Authorization Key to ensure the latest authorization data is used for fraud processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve current authorization record from database using Account ID and Authorization Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has selected a specific pending authorization record on the Authorization Detail screen, and the session contains a valid Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and a selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user initiates a fraud marking action (PF5) on the selected authorization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the current authorization record from the Pending Authorization database using the Account ID and the Authorization Key as lookup criteria, making the latest authorization details available for fraud status evaluation and update

rules.rule_name: Remove Fraud Confirmation from Already-Flagged Authorization
rules.rule_description: When an authorization has already been confirmed as fraudulent, pressing PF5 toggles the fraud status by removing the fraud confirmation flag and marking the record for fraud removal processing, effectively reversing the prior fraud designation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Authorization Already Confirmed as Fraud? → Yes - Already Fraud → Set Status Flag: FRAUD REMOVED, Mark for Fraud Removal

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current authorization record has been retrieved from the database and its fraud status is already set to FRAUD CONFIRMED (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF5 to toggle the fraud status of this authorization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization fraud status flag to FRAUD REMOVED (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED = TRUE) and sets the action indicator to WS-REMOVE-FRAUD = TRUE, marking this record for fraud removal processing before passing it to the fraud management program

rules.rule_name: Confirm New Fraud on Authorization Not Previously Flagged
rules.rule_description: When an authorization has not previously been flagged as fraudulent, pressing PF5 confirms the authorization as fraud by setting the fraud confirmed flag and marking the record for fraud reporting, initiating the fraud reporting workflow.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Authorization Already Confirmed as Fraud? → No - Not Yet Fraud → Set Status Flag: FRAUD CONFIRMED, Mark for Fraud Reporting

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current authorization record has been retrieved from the database and its fraud status is NOT set to FRAUD CONFIRMED (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is FALSE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF5 to toggle the fraud status of this authorization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization fraud status flag to FRAUD CONFIRMED (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED = TRUE) and sets the action indicator to WS-REPORT-FRAUD = TRUE, marking this record for fraud reporting before passing it to the fraud management program

rules.rule_name: Copy Updated Authorization Details into Fraud Data Package
rules.rule_description: After the fraud status flag has been toggled (either confirmed or removed), the complete updated authorization detail record must be copied into the Fraud Data Package so that the external fraud management program receives the full and current authorization information including the updated fraud status.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Copy updated authorization details into Fraud Data Package

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud status flag on the authorization record has been updated (either set to FRAUD CONFIRMED or FRAUD REMOVED) based on the toggle decision
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Fraud Data Package to be sent to the external fraud management program (COPAUS2C)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the complete updated authorization detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) into the Fraud Data Package (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD), ensuring all authorization fields including the updated fraud status flag are included in the package

rules.rule_name: Assign Account ID to Fraud Data Package
rules.rule_description: The Account ID associated with the authorization must be explicitly assigned to the Fraud Data Package so that the external fraud management program can correctly identify and associate the fraud action with the correct account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Assign Account ID to Fraud Data Package

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Fraud Data Package (WS-FRAUD-DATA) is being prepared with the updated authorization details and the session contains the Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) of the cardholder
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Fraud Data Package before calling the external fraud management program (COPAUS2C)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system assigns the Account ID from the current session (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) to the Account ID field within the Fraud Data Package (WS-FRD-ACCT-ID), ensuring the fraud action is linked to the correct account

rules.rule_name: Assign Customer ID to Fraud Data Package
rules.rule_description: The Customer ID associated with the account must be explicitly assigned to the Fraud Data Package so that the external fraud management program can correctly identify and associate the fraud action with the correct customer record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Assign Customer ID to Fraud Data Package

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Fraud Data Package (WS-FRAUD-DATA) is being prepared with the updated authorization details and Account ID, and the session contains the Customer ID (CDEMO-CUST-ID) of the cardholder
acceptance_criteria.When: The system finalizes the Fraud Data Package before calling the external fraud management program (COPAUS2C)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system assigns the Customer ID from the current session (CDEMO-CUST-ID) to the Customer ID field within the Fraud Data Package (WS-FRD-CUST-ID), ensuring the fraud action is linked to the correct customer, and the Fraud Data Package is now fully prepared and ready for submission to COPAUS2C

rules.rule_name: Invoke External Fraud Management Program with Prepared Fraud Data Package
rules.rule_description: Once the Fraud Data Package is fully prepared with the updated authorization details, fraud status flag, Account ID, and Customer ID, the system must invoke the external fraud management program (COPAUS2C) to process and persist the fraud status change.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End: Fraud Data Package Ready - Proceed to Call COPAUS2C

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Fraud Data Package (WS-FRAUD-DATA) has been fully populated with the updated authorization details (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD), the toggled fraud status flag (FRAUD CONFIRMED or FRAUD REMOVED), the Account ID (WS-FRD-ACCT-ID), and the Customer ID (WS-FRD-CUST-ID)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is ready to process the fraud status change
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system calls the external fraud management program COPAUS2C (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) via a program LINK, passing the complete Fraud Data Package (WS-FRAUD-DATA) as the communication area, delegating the fraud update persistence to the external program

key_functionalities.title: Fraud Update Success Handling

rules.rule_name: Apply Updated Fraud Record to Authorization Detail Before Saving
rules.rule_description: When the external fraud program confirms a successful fraud status update, the system must apply the updated fraud record data to the Authorization Detail record in preparation for saving to the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Move updated fraud record to Authorization Detail

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud program has returned a successful update response, and the updated fraud authorization record (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD) contains the latest fraud status and fraud report date
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to persist the fraud status change to the Authorization Detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The updated fraud authorization record (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD) is applied to the Pending Authorization Detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS), overwriting the previous authorization detail data with the new fraud-tagged version before the database save is attempted

rules.rule_name: Save Updated Authorization Detail Record to Database
rules.rule_description: After the updated fraud record has been applied to the Authorization Detail, the system must persist the updated Authorization Detail record to the database by replacing the existing record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save updated Authorization Detail Record to Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Pending Authorization Detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) has been updated with the new fraud status information from the fraud program
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to save the updated Authorization Detail record to the database
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system replaces the existing Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1) in the database with the updated Pending Authorization Detail record, and the database operation result status is captured for success or failure evaluation

rules.rule_name: Commit Transaction on Successful Authorization Detail Update
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Detail record is successfully saved to the database, the system must commit the transaction to make the fraud status change permanent.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Commit Transaction to Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully saved to the database with the updated fraud status (database update status is OK)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms the database update was successful
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system commits the transaction (SYNCPOINT), permanently persisting the fraud status change to the Authorization Detail record in the database

rules.rule_name: Display Success Message When Fraud Flag Is Removed
rules.rule_description: After a successful database commit, if the fraud action was a removal of a previously confirmed fraud flag, the system must display a specific confirmation message to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Success Message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully updated and committed to the database, and the fraud action performed was the removal of a previously confirmed fraud flag (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines which success message to display based on the type of fraud action performed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' to the user, confirming that the fraud flag has been successfully removed from the authorization

rules.rule_name: Display Success Message When Authorization Is Marked as Fraud
rules.rule_description: After a successful database commit, if the fraud action was a confirmation of fraud on the authorization, the system must display a specific confirmation message to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Success Message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully updated and committed to the database, and the fraud action performed was confirming the authorization as fraudulent (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED is false, meaning PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED was set)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines which success message to display based on the type of fraud action performed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' to the user, confirming that the authorization has been successfully flagged as fraudulent

rules.rule_name: Rollback Transaction and Display Error When Database Update Fails
rules.rule_description: If the Authorization Detail record cannot be successfully saved to the database, the system must rollback the entire transaction to prevent partial or inconsistent data, and display an error message to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Rollback Transaction
Display System Error Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system attempted to save the updated Authorization Detail record to the database, and the database update operation returned a non-successful status (status is not OK)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that the database update has failed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system rolls back the entire transaction (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) to undo any changes made during this operation, sets the error flag to 'Y', and displays a system error message indicating that the fraud tagging operation failed along with the database error status code, then refreshes the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Route Fraud Update Outcome Based on External Fraud Program Response
rules.rule_description: After the external fraud program is called, the system must evaluate the fraud program's update result to determine whether to proceed with saving the authorization detail or to rollback and display the fraud program's error message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Fraud Program Returns Success

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external fraud management program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) has been called and returned a normal CICS response, meaning the program executed without a system-level failure
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the fraud program's business-level update result (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the fraud program reports a successful update (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is true), the system proceeds to update the Authorization Detail record in the database; if the fraud program reports an unsuccessful update (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is false), the system displays the fraud program's action message (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG) to the user and rolls back the transaction

rules.rule_name: Refresh Authorization Detail Screen After Fraud Action Completion
rules.rule_description: After any fraud action (successful or failed), the system must refresh the Authorization Detail screen with the current state of the authorization record so the user sees the latest fraud status.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate and Refresh Authorization Detail Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud mark or fraud removal action has been completed (either successfully committed or rolled back), and the authorization key is available from the Pending Authorization Detail record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to return the updated view to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the currently selected authorization key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED) to the authorization key from the Pending Authorization Detail record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY), then populates and refreshes the Authorization Detail screen with all current authorization fields including the updated fraud status, displaying the current fraud flag and fraud report date if fraud has been confirmed or removed, or a '-' if no fraud history exists

key_functionalities.title: Fraud Update Failure Handling
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

    F[Display Error Message\nto User]

    A --> B
    B -->|No - Program Call Failed| G
    G --> H

    F --> H
    C -->|Yes - Update Succeeded| H

rules.rule_name: Evaluate Fraud Program Execution Outcome
rules.rule_description: When the external Fraud Management program is called to mark or unmark an authorization as fraud, the system must evaluate whether the program completed its execution without failure before proceeding with any database updates.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Did Fraud Program Complete Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record has been submitted to the external Fraud Management program to either confirm or remove a fraud flag
acceptance_criteria.When: The external Fraud Management program returns a response to the Authorization Detail screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Fraud Management program completed successfully, the system proceeds to check whether the fraud data update itself was successful; if the program did not complete successfully (call failure), the system immediately rolls back all pending database changes without displaying any fraud program error message

rules.rule_name: Evaluate Fraud Data Update Result from Fraud Program
rules.rule_description: After confirming the external Fraud Management program completed successfully, the system must further evaluate whether the fraud data update operation within that program was actually successful before committing any changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Did Fraud Program Return Update Success?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Management program has completed its execution successfully and returned a response
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the fraud update success indicator returned by the Fraud Management program
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the fraud update was successful, the system proceeds to commit the authorization record update to the database; if the fraud update was not successful, the system captures the error message returned by the Fraud Management program, rolls back all pending database changes, and displays the captured error message to the user

rules.rule_name: Capture Fraud Program Error Message on Update Failure
rules.rule_description: When the external Fraud Management program reports that the fraud data update was unsuccessful, the system must capture the specific error message returned by the fraud program so it can be communicated to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture Error Message Returned from Fraud Program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Management program has completed execution but reported that the fraud data update was not successful
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the unsuccessful fraud update response
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the action error message (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG) returned by the Fraud Management program and stores it as the current screen message to be displayed to the user

rules.rule_name: Rollback Database Changes on Fraud Update Failure
rules.rule_description: When the external Fraud Management program reports that the fraud data update was unsuccessful, all pending database changes related to the fraud marking or unmarking operation must be undone to preserve data integrity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19: Rollback Database Changes
Undo any pending
database updates

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Management program completed execution but returned an unsuccessful fraud update result, and the fraud program's error message has been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the fraud update failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs a full rollback of all pending database changes, ensuring no partial fraud status updates are committed to the authorization record, and then displays the fraud program's error message to the user on the Authorization Detail screen

rules.rule_name: Rollback Database Changes on Fraud Program Call Failure
rules.rule_description: When the external Fraud Management program itself fails to execute (program call failure), all pending database changes must be immediately rolled back without any error message from the fraud program, since no response was received.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19: Rollback Database Changes
Undo any pending
database updates

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization record's fraud status change has been initiated and submitted to the external Fraud Management program
acceptance_criteria.When: The external Fraud Management program fails to complete its execution (the program call itself does not return a normal response)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system performs a full rollback of all pending database changes immediately, no fraud program error message is displayed (since none was returned), and the system continues to refresh the Authorization Detail screen in its pre-update state

rules.rule_name: Display Fraud Update Error Message to User
rules.rule_description: After rolling back database changes due to a fraud update failure, the system must display the error message received from the Fraud Management program to inform the user why the fraud marking or unmarking operation could not be completed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message to User

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud data update has failed, the fraud program's error message has been captured, and the database rollback has been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: The Authorization Detail screen is refreshed after the failed fraud operation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error message returned by the Fraud Management program is displayed in the message area of the Authorization Detail screen, the screen header is refreshed with the current date and time, and the authorization details remain visible so the user can review the current state of the record

rules.rule_name: Prepare Updated Authorization Detail Record with Fraud Status
rules.rule_description: Before saving to the database, the system prepares the authorization detail record by applying the updated fraud status and fraud report date from the fraud processing workspace into the pending authorization detail record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Prepare updated authorization details with new fraud status and report date

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud status toggle action (mark or remove fraud) has been processed for a selected authorization record, and the fraud processing workspace (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD) contains the updated authorization details including the new fraud status flag and fraud report date
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is ready to persist the fraud status change to the authorization detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the complete updated authorization detail record from the fraud processing workspace into the pending authorization detail record, ensuring the new fraud status and fraud report date are included before the database save is attempted

rules.rule_name: Save Updated Authorization Detail Record to Database
rules.rule_description: The system replaces the existing authorization detail record in the database with the updated record containing the new fraud status and report date.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Save updated authorization detail record to database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The pending authorization detail record has been prepared with the updated fraud status and fraud report date, and the authorization detail segment (PAUTDTL1) exists in the database under the correct account
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to replace the existing authorization detail record in the database
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must overwrite the existing authorization detail record with the updated record containing the new fraud status; the outcome of the save operation (success or failure) must be captured to determine the next processing step

rules.rule_name: Commit Transaction on Successful Authorization Detail Update
rules.rule_description: When the authorization detail record is successfully saved to the database, the system must commit the transaction to make all changes permanent and irreversible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 21: Commit Transaction - Make changes permanent

acceptance_criteria.Given: The updated authorization detail record with the new fraud status and report date has been successfully saved to the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The database save operation completes with a successful status
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must immediately commit (take a syncpoint) to make all database changes permanent, ensuring the fraud status update is durably recorded

rules.rule_name: Display Fraud Removal Confirmation Message After Successful Update
rules.rule_description: After a successful database save and commit, if the fraud flag was being removed from the authorization, the system displays a specific confirmation message to inform the user that the fraud marking has been reversed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Success Message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization detail record has been successfully saved and the transaction has been committed, and the fraud action performed was a removal of a previously confirmed fraud flag (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines the type of fraud action that was completed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display the message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' to confirm to the user that the fraud flag has been successfully removed from the authorization record

rules.rule_name: Display Fraud Confirmation Message After Successful Update
rules.rule_description: After a successful database save and commit, if the fraud flag was being added to the authorization, the system displays a specific confirmation message to inform the user that the authorization has been successfully marked as fraudulent.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Success Message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The authorization detail record has been successfully saved and the transaction has been committed, and the fraud action performed was a confirmation of fraud (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED is false, meaning fraud was confirmed/added)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines the type of fraud action that was completed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must display the message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' to confirm to the user that the authorization record has been successfully flagged as fraudulent

rules.rule_name: Rollback Transaction on Failed Authorization Detail Update
rules.rule_description: If the database save of the updated authorization detail record fails for any reason, the system must rollback the entire transaction to undo all changes and preserve data integrity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 22: Rollback Transaction - Undo all database changes

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system attempted to save the updated authorization detail record with the new fraud status to the database, and the save operation did not complete successfully (any status other than success)
acceptance_criteria.When: The database save operation returns a failure status
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must immediately rollback the transaction (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) to undo all database changes made during this transaction, ensuring no partial or inconsistent fraud status updates are persisted to the authorization record

key_functionalities.title: Transaction Commit
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

    D[Set Success Message:\n'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...']
    E[Set Success Message:\n'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...']
    F([Proceed to\nDisplay Screen])

    A --> C
    C --> B
    B -->|Yes - Fraud Flag Removed| D
    B -->|No - Fraud Flag Added| E
    D --> F
    E --> F

rules.rule_name: Commit Database Changes After Successful Authorization Fraud Update
rules.rule_description: When an authorization detail record has been successfully updated in the database (either marking or removing a fraud flag), all pending database changes must be permanently committed to ensure data integrity and consistency.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Commit All Database Changes to make them permanent

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully updated in the database with the new fraud status (either fraud confirmed or fraud removed), and the database update operation returned a successful status
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the successful database update result for the authorization detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must immediately commit all pending database changes to make them permanent and irreversible, ensuring the fraud status update is durably recorded

rules.rule_name: Display Fraud Removal Success Confirmation Message
rules.rule_description: After a successful database commit following a fraud flag removal action, the system must inform the user that the fraud marking has been successfully removed from the authorization record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Success Message: 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully updated in the database and all changes have been committed, AND the action performed was the removal of a previously confirmed fraud flag (fraud flag was toggled from confirmed to removed)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the type of fraud action that was committed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set and display the success message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' to confirm to the user that the fraud flag has been successfully removed from the authorization record

rules.rule_name: Display Fraud Confirmation Success Message
rules.rule_description: After a successful database commit following a fraud flag confirmation action, the system must inform the user that the authorization record has been successfully marked as fraudulent.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Success Message: 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been successfully updated in the database and all changes have been committed, AND the action performed was the confirmation of fraud (fraud flag was toggled from not-confirmed to confirmed)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the type of fraud action that was committed and determines that the fraud flag was NOT removed (i.e., it was added/confirmed)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set and display the success message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' to confirm to the user that the authorization record has been successfully flagged as fraudulent

rules.rule_name: Invoke External Fraud Management Program to Process Fraud Status Update
rules.rule_description: When a fraud status toggle is initiated for an authorization record, the system must invoke the external Fraud Management program, passing the authorization details, account ID, and customer ID, before any database changes are committed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Fraud Status Update Attempted

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has requested to mark or unmark an authorization as fraudulent, and the authorization detail record, account ID (WS-FRD-ACCT-ID), and customer ID (WS-FRD-CUST-ID) have been populated in the fraud data communication area (WS-FRAUD-DATA)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system invokes the external Fraud Management program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) via a program link, passing the fraud data communication area containing the full authorization detail record, account ID, and customer ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: The external Fraud Management program is called and the system waits for a response before proceeding with any database update or rollback action

rules.rule_name: Rollback All Changes When External Fraud Program Call Fails
rules.rule_description: If the system is unable to successfully communicate with the external Fraud Management program (i.e., the program link itself fails), all pending changes for the transaction must be rolled back immediately without any database update being applied.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: CICS Link to Fraud Program Successful?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud status toggle has been initiated for an authorization record and the external Fraud Management program has been invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: The program link to the external Fraud Management program returns a non-normal response (i.e., the call itself fails, not a business-level failure)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system immediately initiates a rollback of all database changes for the current transaction, ensuring no partial updates are saved, and displays an error message to the user

rules.rule_name: Capture Fraud Program Business Failure Message Before Rollback
rules.rule_description: When the external Fraud Management program is successfully called but reports that the fraud update was not successful at the business level, the system must capture the error message returned by the fraud program and display it to the user after rolling back all changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture Error Message from Fraud Program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Management program was successfully invoked (program link succeeded) and has returned a response
acceptance_criteria.When: The fraud program indicates that the fraud update was NOT successful (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is false), and the fraud program has returned an action message (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the error message returned by the fraud program (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG) into the screen message field (WS-MESSAGE), initiates a rollback of all database changes, and displays the captured fraud program error message to the user

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Database Update When Fraud Program Confirms Success
rules.rule_description: When the external Fraud Management program is successfully called and confirms that the fraud status update was processed successfully, the system proceeds to update the authorization detail record in the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Fraud Program Returned Success?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The external Fraud Management program was successfully invoked (program link returned normal response)
acceptance_criteria.When: The fraud program confirms a successful update (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to update the authorization detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) in the database with the fraud-tagged data from WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD

rules.rule_name: Commit Changes and Confirm Fraud Status Update When Database Update Succeeds
rules.rule_description: When the authorization detail record is successfully updated in the database with the new fraud status, the system commits the transaction and displays a confirmation message indicating whether fraud was marked or removed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Database Record Update Successful?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud program confirmed success and the system has attempted to update the authorization detail record (PAUTDTL1 segment) in the database with the fraud-tagged data
acceptance_criteria.When: The database update operation completes successfully (status is OK)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system commits all changes via a syncpoint, and displays either 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' if the fraud flag was being removed (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED is true), or 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' if the authorization was being confirmed as fraudulent (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is true)

rules.rule_name: Capture System Error Message When Database Update Fails During Fraud Tagging
rules.rule_description: When the database update of the authorization detail record fails during fraud tagging, the system must capture a descriptive system error message indicating the failure context before initiating a rollback.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture System Error Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The fraud program confirmed success and the system has attempted to update the authorization detail record in the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The database update operation fails (status is not OK)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system constructs an error message containing the text 'System error while FRAUD Tagging, ROLLBACK' concatenated with the database return code, stores it in WS-MESSAGE, initiates a rollback of all database changes, and displays the error message to the user

rules.rule_name: Rollback All Database Changes to Preserve Data Integrity on Any Fraud Update Failure
rules.rule_description: Whenever any failure occurs during the fraud status update process — whether the fraud program call failed, the fraud program reported a business failure, or the database update failed — all database changes made during the current transaction must be fully rolled back to ensure data integrity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Rollback All Database Changes for This Transaction

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fraud status update has been attempted and a failure has occurred at any stage: the program link to the fraud management program failed, the fraud program reported an unsuccessful update, or the database record update failed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates a rollback
acceptance_criteria.Then: All database changes made during the current transaction are fully reversed via a CICS Syncpoint Rollback, ensuring no partial or inconsistent fraud data is saved to the database

rules.rule_name: Display Error Message to User After Rollback
rules.rule_description: After a rollback is executed due to any fraud update failure, the system must display the relevant error message to the user on the Authorization Detail screen, informing them that no changes were saved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message to User

acceptance_criteria.Given: A rollback has been executed due to a failure in the fraud status update process (either fraud program link failure, fraud program business failure, or database update failure), and an error message has been captured in WS-MESSAGE
acceptance_criteria.When: The rollback completes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sends the Authorization Detail screen (COPAU1A from mapset COPAU01) to the user with the error message displayed in the ERRMSGO field, and the screen header is refreshed with the current date and time, so the user is informed that the fraud update failed and no changes were saved
