Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the authorization is currently marked as Fraud Confirmed, the system sets the fraud status to Fraud Removed and flags the action as 'Remove Fraud'; if the authorization is NOT currently marked as fraud, the system sets the fraud status to Fraud Confirmed and flags the action as 'Report Fraud'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Toggle Fraud Status of Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF5 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system evaluates the current fraud status of the authorization and toggles it: if already marked as fraud, the fraud flag is removed; if not marked as fraud, it is confirmed as fraud.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The fraud status toggle has been determined (either Fraud Confirmed or Fraud Removed) for the current authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the data package to send to the external fraud program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates the fraud data package with: the complete authorization detail record (all authorization fields), the Account ID from the current session, and the Customer ID from the current session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Prepare Fraud Data Package for External Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before delegating to the external fraud processing program, the system assembles a fraud data package containing the full authorization detail record, the Account ID, and the Customer ID associated with the authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The fraud data package has been prepared with the authorization details, Account ID, and Customer ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system invokes the external Fraud Processing Program by passing the fraud data package
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The external Fraud Processing Program (COPAUS2C) is called with the complete fraud data package, and the system waits for the program to return a success or failure response

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delegate Fraud Status Update to External Fraud Processing Program
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system delegates the fraud status update operation to the external Fraud Processing Program (COPAUS2C), passing the assembled fraud data package for processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program has been called with the fraud data package
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system receives the response from the external Fraud Processing Program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the program call completed successfully AND the fraud update was confirmed as successful by the fraud program, the system proceeds to save the updated fraud status to the database; if the program call completed successfully BUT the fraud update was NOT successful, the system rolls back all changes and displays the error message returned by the fraud program; if the program call itself failed (non-normal response), the system rolls back all changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Fraud Program Response to Determine Next Action
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the external fraud program completes, the system evaluates whether the call was successful and whether the fraud update was applied, to determine whether to proceed with saving the update or to rollback all changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program has confirmed a successful fraud status update
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to save the updated authorization record to the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system writes the updated authorization detail record (containing the new fraud status flag and fraud report date) to the authorization details database segment; if the save is successful, the system proceeds to commit the changes; if the save fails, the system rolls back all changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Updated Fraud Status to Authorization Database
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the external fraud program confirms a successful update, the system saves the updated authorization record (including the new fraud status and fraud report date) back to the authorization details database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The updated authorization record with the new fraud status has been successfully saved to the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system confirms the database save was successful
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system commits all pending changes, making the fraud status update permanent and irreversible until a future action changes it

all_rules.Rule_Name: Commit Fraud Status Changes on Successful Database Save
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization record has been successfully updated in the database with the new fraud status, the system commits all changes to make them permanent.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The fraud status update has been committed successfully and the action taken was to confirm fraud (not remove it)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that the fraud action was a fraud confirmation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' on the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Confirmation Message When Authorization is Marked as Fraud
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully committing a fraud confirmation, the system displays a confirmation message to inform the user that the authorization has been marked as fraud.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The fraud status update has been committed successfully and the action taken was to remove the fraud flag
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that the fraud action was a fraud removal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' on the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Confirmation Message When Authorization Fraud Flag is Removed
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully committing a fraud removal, the system displays a confirmation message to inform the user that the fraud flag has been removed from the authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program confirmed a successful update, but the system's attempt to save the updated authorization record to the database failed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database save operation returns a non-successful status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system rolls back all changes made during the current fraud toggle operation, ensuring no partial updates are retained in the database

all_rules.Rule_Name: Rollback All Changes When Database Save of Fraud Status Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the system fails to save the updated fraud status to the authorization database, all changes made during the fraud toggle operation are rolled back to preserve data integrity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program was called with the fraud data package
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The fraud program call fails (non-normal system response) OR the fraud program returns an unsuccessful update status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system rolls back all changes made during the current fraud toggle operation; if the fraud program returned an error message, that specific error message is displayed on the Authorization Detail screen to inform the user of the reason for failure

all_rules.Rule_Name: Rollback All Changes and Display Error When Fraud Program Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the external Fraud Processing Program returns a failure (either the program call itself failed or the program reported an unsuccessful update), all changes are rolled back and the error message from the fraud program is displayed to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is viewing an authorization detail screen and presses PF8 to navigate to the next authorization, and the session contains a valid Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and a currently selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates the next-authorization navigation process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system uses the current Account ID and the currently selected Authorization Key to locate and position to the current authorization record in the Pending Authorization database, establishing the correct starting position for fetching the next sequential record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position to Current Authorization Record Before Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before navigating to the next authorization, the system must first position itself to the currently selected authorization record using the account ID and the currently selected authorization key, so that the next sequential record can be correctly identified.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully positioned to the current authorization detail record for the account in the Pending Authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system requests the next sequential authorization detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the immediately following authorization detail record in sequence for the same account; if a next record exists, the end-of-records indicator is set to NOT-EOF; if no further records exist (end of data or segment not found), the end-of-records indicator is set to EOF

all_rules.Rule_Name: Fetch Next Sequential Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After positioning to the current authorization record, the system fetches the next sequential authorization detail record for the same account from the Pending Authorization database without applying any specific key filter, relying on sequential order.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to fetch the next sequential authorization detail record for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the fetch operation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the fetch was successful (STATUS-OK), the end-of-records indicator is set to NOT-EOF and the system proceeds to display the next authorization; if the fetch returned segment-not-found or end-of-database, the end-of-records indicator is set to EOF and the system displays the end-of-list message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Availability of Next Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After attempting to fetch the next authorization record, the system evaluates whether a next record was successfully retrieved or whether the end of the authorization list has been reached, to determine the appropriate action to take.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully fetched the next sequential authorization detail record (end-of-records indicator is NOT-EOF)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to display the next authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The session's currently selected authorization key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED) is updated with the Authorization Key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY) from the newly retrieved authorization detail record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Selected Authorization Key to Next Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a next authorization record is successfully retrieved, the system updates the session's currently selected authorization key to reflect the newly retrieved authorization record, so that subsequent operations reference the correct record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF8 to navigate to the next authorization and the system determines that no further authorization records exist (end-of-records indicator is EOF)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the end-of-list condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the screen erase flag to NO (so the current screen content is preserved and not cleared), and sets the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' to be displayed to the user on the refreshed screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display End-of-List Message When No Further Authorizations Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to navigate past the last authorization record in the list, the system informs the user that no further authorizations are available and retains the current screen content without erasing it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail screen fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization origination date stored as YYMMDD is reformatted by extracting characters 1-2 as Year (YY), characters 3-4 as Month (MM), and characters 5-6 as Day (DD), and the date is displayed on screen in MM/DD/YY format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Date in MM/DD/YY Display Format
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization origination date stored in the system in YYMMDD format must be reformatted into MM/DD/YY format before being displayed on the authorization detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization time field on screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization origination time is formatted by placing characters 1-2 into positions 1-2 (hours), characters 3-4 into positions 4-5 (minutes), and characters 5-6 into positions 7-8 (seconds) of the display time field, resulting in HH:MM:SS format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Authorization Time in HH:MM:SS Display Format
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization origination time stored in the system must be formatted into HH:MM:SS format before being displayed on the authorization detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) to determine the transaction outcome
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the response code is '00', the status field (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'A' (Approved) and displayed in GREEN; if the response code is any value other than '00', the status field is set to 'D' (Declined) and displayed in RED

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Authorization Approval or Decline Status with Color Indicator
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization response code determines whether the transaction was approved or declined, and the screen must display the appropriate status indicator with a corresponding color to visually distinguish approvals from declines.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system searches the Decline Reason table (WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB) for a matching entry where the decline code (DECL-CODE) equals the authorization response reason (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If a matching entry is found, the decline reason field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with the reason code in positions 1-4, a '-' separator in position 5, and the decline description (DECL-DESC) from position 6 onward (e.g., '1001-INSUFFICIENT FUNDS'); if no matching entry is found, the field is populated with '9999' in positions 1-4, '-' in position 5, and 'ERROR' from position 6 onward (i.e., '9999-ERROR')

all_rules.Rule_Name: Look Up and Display Decline Reason Description
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization response reason code must be looked up in the predefined Decline Reason table to retrieve a human-readable description, which is then displayed alongside the reason code on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the card expiry date display field (CRDEXPO)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card expiry date is displayed in MM/YY format by placing the first 2 characters of PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE into positions 1-2 (month), a '/' character into position 3, and the last 2 characters of PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE into positions 4-5 (year)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Card Expiry Date with Slash Separator for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card expiry date stored in the system must be formatted with a '/' separator between the month and year portions before being displayed on the authorization detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the fraud status of the authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the authorization has been confirmed as fraud (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED) OR has had its fraud flag removed (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED), the fraud display field (AUTHFRDO) is populated with the fraud flag indicator (PA-AUTH-FRAUD) in position 1, a '-' separator in position 2, and the fraud report date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE) from position 3 onward; if neither condition is true (no fraud history), the fraud display field is set to '-' only

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Fraud Status with Flag and Report Date When Fraud History Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: The fraud status field on the authorization detail screen must reflect whether the authorization has any fraud history, displaying the fraud flag and report date when applicable, or a neutral indicator when no fraud history exists.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the error flag is OFF
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields are populated from the retrieved authorization record: Card Number (PA-CARD-NUM → CARDNUMO), Approved Amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT → AUTHAMTO), Processing Code (PA-PROCESSING-CODE → AUTHCDO), POS Entry Mode (PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE → POSEMDO), Message Source (PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE → AUTHSRCO), Merchant Category Code (PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE → MCCCDO), Authorization Type (PA-AUTH-TYPE → AUTHTYPO), Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID → TRNIDO), Match Status (PA-MATCH-STATUS → AUTHMTCO), Merchant Name (PA-MERCHANT-NAME → MERNAMEO), Merchant ID (PA-MERCHANT-ID → MERIDO), Merchant City (PA-MERCHANT-CITY → MERCITYO), Merchant State (PA-MERCHANT-STATE → MERSTO), and Merchant ZIP (PA-MERCHANT-ZIP → MERZIPO)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate All Remaining Authorization Detail Fields for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a next authorization record is successfully retrieved, all authorization and merchant detail fields must be populated on the screen from the retrieved record data, provided no error condition exists.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Authorization Detail screen and has an active session with a previously selected authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF5, or PF8
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system identifies the key press as unsupported and initiates the invalid key handling process, which includes reloading the current authorization record and displaying an invalid key message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Unsupported Function Key Press on Authorization Detail Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses any function key that is not ENTER, PF3, PF5, or PF8 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system identifies it as an unsupported/invalid key action and triggers the invalid key handling workflow.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed an unsupported function key on the Authorization Detail screen, and the session contains a valid numeric Account ID and a previously selected Authorization record key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the invalid key event by re-executing the authorization record retrieval
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads the authorization summary record for the Account ID and retrieves the matching authorization detail record using the Authorization key; if the Account ID is not numeric or no authorization is selected, an error flag is set and no authorization details are loaded

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reload Current Authorization Detail Record on Invalid Key Press
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an unsupported key is pressed, the system reloads the current authorization detail record using the existing Account ID and selected Authorization key from the session, ensuring the screen retains all previously displayed authorization information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has detected that the user pressed an unsupported function key and has reloaded the current authorization detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the Authorization Detail screen for redisplay
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the message field to the standard invalid key message defined in the application constants (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY), which will be displayed in the error message area of the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Invalid Key Message for Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: After detecting an unsupported key press, the system sets the standard invalid key message (sourced from the application message constants CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) into the screen message field to inform the user that the key they pressed is not a supported action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The invalid key message has been set and the current authorization detail record has been loaded into the screen output fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Authorization Detail screen back to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen is displayed with: (1) the invalid key error message shown in the error message area (ERRMSGO), (2) all current authorization detail fields populated as previously displayed, (3) the screen header updated with the current system date (MM/DD/YY) and current system time (HH:MM:SS), (4) the transaction name and program name shown in the header, and (5) the screen is sent with ERASE to fully refresh the display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Authorization Detail Screen with Invalid Key Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Authorization Detail screen is refreshed and redisplayed to the user with the invalid key message shown in the error message area, along with the current authorization details and an updated header showing the current system date and time.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID and an Authorization Key are available in the current session context
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates an authorization record retrieval process using the Account ID to locate the corresponding Authorization Summary record in the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system searches the Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID as the lookup key, and the result determines whether processing continues to the Authorization Detail retrieval step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Search Authorization Summary Records by Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: When retrieving authorization details, the system first searches for the Authorization Summary record using the Account ID as the primary search key before attempting to retrieve the associated detail record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the Authorization Summary data store using the Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No matching Authorization Summary record is found for the given Account ID, or the database indicates there are no more records to retrieve
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization retrieval status to 'End of Records' (AUTHS-EOF), and no further attempt is made to retrieve the Authorization Detail record; control is returned to the calling process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization Summary Record Not Found – Mark End of Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: If no Authorization Summary record exists for the given Account ID, or there are no more records available, the system marks the retrieval status as end-of-records and stops further processing for this retrieval request.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record has been successfully found for the given Account ID, and the authorization retrieval status is set to 'Not End of Records'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system proceeds to the next step of the retrieval process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system searches the Authorization Detail data store using the Authorization Key as the lookup key, scoped within the parent Authorization Summary record, to retrieve the specific authorization transaction details

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization Summary Found – Proceed to Search Authorization Detail
all_rules.Rule_Description: Only when an Authorization Summary record is successfully found for the Account ID does the system proceed to retrieve the corresponding Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record was found and the system has searched for the Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No matching Authorization Detail record is found for the given Authorization Key within the parent summary record, or the database indicates there are no more detail records
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization retrieval status to 'End of Records' (AUTHS-EOF), and control is returned to the calling process with no authorization detail data populated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization Detail Record Not Found – Mark End of Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: If no Authorization Detail record matching the Authorization Key is found within the parent Authorization Summary, or there are no more detail records available, the system marks the retrieval status as end-of-records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched for both the Authorization Summary record by Account ID and the Authorization Detail record by Authorization Key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Both the Authorization Summary record and the Authorization Detail record are found successfully in the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization retrieval status to 'Not End of Records' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) for both retrievals, the complete Authorization Detail data (including card number, authorization date, time, approved amount, response code, merchant information, fraud status, and all other authorization attributes) is loaded into the working data area, and control is returned to the calling process for further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Authorization Summary and Detail Records Successfully Retrieved
all_rules.Rule_Description: When both the Authorization Summary and Authorization Detail records are successfully found, the system marks the retrieval as successful and makes the full authorization data available for display and processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A request has been made to retrieve authorization information for a specific Account ID and Authorization Key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the authorization record retrieval process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must first successfully locate the Authorization Summary record using the Account ID before it attempts to retrieve the Authorization Detail record using the Authorization Key; if the Authorization Summary is not found, the Authorization Detail retrieval is skipped entirely and the process ends with an end-of-records status

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Two-Step Authorization Record Retrieval Dependency
all_rules.Rule_Description: The retrieval of Authorization Detail records is strictly dependent on the prior successful retrieval of the Authorization Summary record. The system enforces a mandatory two-step sequential lookup: Summary first, then Detail only if Summary is found.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing an authorization detail screen and the session contains a valid Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and a currently selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 to navigate to the next authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the working Account ID (WS-ACCT-ID) to the session Account ID and sets the working Authorization Key (WS-AUTH-KEY) to the currently selected Authorization Key from the session, establishing the current position for forward navigation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Navigation Context from Current Session for PF8 Forward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF8 to navigate forward, the system retrieves the current Account ID and the currently selected Authorization Key from the active session to establish the navigation starting point.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The working Account ID (WS-ACCT-ID) and Authorization Key (WS-AUTH-KEY) have been set from the session data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates forward navigation by pressing PF8
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system first retrieves the Authorization Summary record for the given Account ID, and then retrieves the specific Authorization Detail record matching the current Authorization Key, positioning the database cursor at the current record so that the next sequential record can be retrieved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Database Cursor at Current Authorization Record Before Forward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before retrieving the next authorization, the system must first read the current authorization's summary and detail records to correctly position the database cursor, enabling sequential forward navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The database cursor is positioned at the current authorization detail record for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the next sequential authorization detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next authorization detail record in sequence; if a record is found, the authorization status is set to 'records available' (AUTHS-NOT-EOF); if no further records exist (end of data or segment not found), the authorization status is set to 'end of records' (AUTHS-EOF)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Next Sequential Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After positioning at the current authorization record, the system retrieves the next sequential authorization detail record for the same account without specifying a key, relying on the current database cursor position.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the last authorization detail record for the account and presses PF8 to navigate forward
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to read the next sequential authorization record and the end-of-records condition (AUTHS-EOF) is detected
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the screen refresh mode to 'no erase' (SEND-ERASE-NO) so the current screen content is preserved, and sets the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' to be displayed to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect End of Authorization Records and Display Boundary Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to navigate past the last authorization record, the system detects the end-of-records condition and informs the user that no further authorizations are available, while preserving the current screen content.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The next sequential authorization detail record has been successfully retrieved (AUTHS-NOT-EOF) and the record contains a valid Authorization Key (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system confirms that a next authorization record exists
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system updates the session's selected authorization key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED) with the Authorization Key from the newly retrieved record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY), making the next authorization the currently selected one

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Session with Next Authorization Key Upon Successful Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the next authorization record is successfully retrieved, the system updates the session's selected authorization key with the key from the newly retrieved record, making it the new current authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The next authorization record has been successfully retrieved and the session's selected authorization key has been updated, and no error flag is active (ERR-FLG-OFF)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the following fields from the next authorization record: Card Number, Authorization Date (formatted as MM/DD/YY), Authorization Time (formatted as HH:MM:SS), Approved Amount, Response Status ('A' for Approved in green if response code is '00', or 'D' for Declined in red for any other code), Decline Reason (looked up from the Decline Reason Table by reason code — showing code and description, or '9999-ERROR' if not found), Processing Code, POS Entry Mode, Message Source, Merchant Category Code, Card Expiry Date (formatted as MM/YY with '/' separator), Authorization Type, Transaction ID, Match Status, Fraud Status (fraud flag + '-' + fraud report date if fraud confirmed or removed, otherwise '-'), Merchant Name, Merchant ID, Merchant City, Merchant State, and Merchant ZIP

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Screen Fields with Next Authorization Detail Information
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully navigating to the next authorization, the system populates all authorization detail fields on the screen with the data from the newly retrieved authorization record, including card, transaction, merchant, and fraud information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: PF8 navigation processing has completed, the screen header has been populated with the current system date and time, and the error message area has been updated with either a navigation message or an end-of-records message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the authorization detail screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the screen erase flag is set to 'YES' (SEND-ERASE-YES) — which is the case when a next record was found — the screen is fully erased and redrawn with the next authorization's details; if the screen erase flag is set to 'NO' (SEND-ERASE-NO) — which is the case when end-of-records was detected — the screen is refreshed without erasing, preserving the current authorization data and displaying the message 'Already at the last Authorization...'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Refresh Screen Display After PF8 Navigation with Conditional Erase
all_rules.Rule_Description: After PF8 navigation processing is complete, the system refreshes the authorization detail screen. The screen is fully erased and redrawn when a next record is found, but is refreshed without erasing when the end-of-records boundary is reached, preserving the last visible authorization data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Authorization Detail screen with a valid Account ID and a currently selected Authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 to navigate to the next authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the current Account ID and the currently selected Authorization Key as the lookup criteria and begins the process of reading the current and next authorization records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Next Authorization Navigation via PF8
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF8 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system initiates the process to navigate to the next pending authorization record for the same account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 and the system has the current Account ID and Authorization Key available in the session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates the next-authorization navigation process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads the Authorization Summary record for the current Account ID and then reads the Authorization Detail record matching the current Authorization Key, establishing the correct position in the authorization record set before attempting to retrieve the next record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Current Authorization Record Before Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before attempting to retrieve the next authorization record, the system must first re-read the current authorization record to establish the correct database position for sequential navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully positioned on the current authorization record in the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to read the next authorization detail record sequentially
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next Authorization Detail record in sequence; if a record is found, the end-of-records flag is set to NOT-EOF; if no further records exist (segment not found or end of database), the end-of-records flag is set to EOF

all_rules.Rule_Name: Attempt to Read Next Sequential Authorization Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After positioning on the current authorization record, the system attempts to retrieve the next authorization detail record in sequence for the same account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to read the next authorization record after the currently displayed one
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The result of the next-record read is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the read returns a 'segment not found' or 'end of database' status, the system sets the end-of-records flag (AUTHS-EOF) to TRUE, indicating no more authorization records are available; if the read is successful, the end-of-records flag is set to NOT-EOF

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect End of Authorization Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: After attempting to read the next authorization record, the system evaluates whether any further authorization records exist for the account to determine the appropriate screen behavior.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The end-of-records flag (AUTHS-EOF) is TRUE, indicating the user is already viewing the last authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to refresh the Authorization Detail screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the screen send mode to 'No Erase' (SEND-ERASE-NO), so the current authorization details remain visible on screen and are not cleared during the screen refresh

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Partial Screen Refresh When at Last Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has reached the last authorization record and no further records exist, the screen must be refreshed without fully erasing the current display, preserving the currently visible authorization details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The end-of-records flag is TRUE, indicating no more authorization records exist beyond the currently displayed one, and the screen is set to partial refresh mode
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Authorization Detail screen is sent to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' in the message area of the screen, while keeping the current authorization details visible

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display End-of-Records Message for Last Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to navigate past the last available authorization record, the system must inform the user that no further authorization records exist.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The end-of-records flag is NOT-EOF, meaning a next authorization record was successfully retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the successful next-record retrieval
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system updates the session's currently selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED) with the Authorization Key from the newly retrieved next authorization record (PA-AUTHORIZATION-KEY)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Selected Authorization Key to Next Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a next authorization record is successfully found, the system updates the session's selected authorization identifier to reflect the newly retrieved record, so subsequent actions operate on the correct authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The session's selected Authorization Key has been updated to the next authorization record and no error flag is set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Authorization Detail screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays all fields of the next authorization record including: Card Number, Authorization Date (formatted as MM/DD/YY), Authorization Time (formatted as HH:MM:SS), Approved Amount, Response Status ('A' in green if response code is '00', 'D' in red otherwise), Decline Reason (looked up from the Decline Reason table by reason code - showing 'code-description' if found, or '9999-ERROR' if not found), Processing Code, POS Entry Mode, Message Source, Merchant Category Code, Card Expiry Date (formatted as MM/YY), Authorization Type, Transaction ID, Match Status, Fraud Status (showing fraud flag + '-' + fraud report date if fraud confirmed or removed, otherwise '-'), Merchant Name, Merchant ID, Merchant City, Merchant State, and Merchant ZIP

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Screen with Next Authorization Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully navigating to the next authorization record, the system populates all authorization detail fields on the screen with the data from the newly selected authorization record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: An error flag is active (error condition exists from a prior processing step such as missing account ID or missing authorization selection)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system skips all authorization detail field population and no screen fields are updated with authorization data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Authorization Detail Population When Error Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must only populate authorization detail screen fields when there are no prior processing errors. If an error condition exists, all field population is bypassed entirely.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card number from the pending authorization record (PA-CARD-NUM) is displayed in the Card Number field (CARDNUMO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Card Number on Authorization Detail Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no error exists, the credit card number associated with the pending authorization record is displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the authorization origination date (PA-AUTH-ORIG-DATE) stored in YYMMDD format where positions 1-2 are YY, positions 3-4 are MM, and positions 5-6 are DD
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The date is rearranged so that MM is placed first, DD second, and YY third, forming the MM/DD/YY display format, and the reformatted date is displayed in the Authorization Date field (AUTHDTO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Display Authorization Origination Date as MM/DD/YY
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization origination date stored in the system in YYMMDD format must be rearranged and displayed in MM/DD/YY format on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the authorization origination time (PA-AUTH-ORIG-TIME) where positions 1-2 are hours (HH), positions 3-4 are minutes (MM), and positions 5-6 are seconds (SS)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The hours are placed in positions 1-2 of the display time field, minutes in positions 4-5, and seconds in positions 7-8 (with colon separators implicitly at positions 3 and 6), and the formatted time is displayed in the Authorization Time field (AUTHTMO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Display Authorization Origination Time as HH:MM:SS
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization origination time stored in the system in HHMMSS format must be formatted with colon separators and displayed as HH:MM:SS on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The approved amount from the pending authorization record (PA-APPROVED-AMT) is moved to the working storage amount field (WS-AUTH-AMT) and then displayed in the Approved Amount field (AUTHAMTO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Approved Amount on Authorization Detail Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The approved dollar amount from the pending authorization record is formatted and displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) equals '00'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The response status field (AUTHRSPO) on the screen is set to 'A' (Approved) and the field color attribute (AUTHRSPC) is set to GREEN

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Authorization Response as Approved with Green Color When Response Code is 00
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization response code is '00', the authorization is considered approved and must be displayed with the letter 'A' highlighted in green color to visually indicate approval.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) is any value other than '00'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The response status field (AUTHRSPO) on the screen is set to 'D' (Declined) and the field color attribute (AUTHRSPC) is set to RED

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Authorization Response as Declined with Red Color When Response Code is Not 00
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization response code is anything other than '00', the authorization is considered declined and must be displayed with the letter 'D' highlighted in red color to visually indicate the decline.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered, no error flag is active, and the authorization response status (Approved or Declined) has been determined
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system searches the Decline Reason Table (WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB) using the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system evaluates whether a matching decline reason code (DECL-CODE) exists in the table and proceeds to display either the matched description or a default error value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Look Up Decline Reason Description from Decline Reason Table
all_rules.Rule_Description: After determining the authorization response status, the system performs a binary search of the Decline Reason Table using the authorization response reason code to find the corresponding human-readable description.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the Decline Reason Table for the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A matching decline reason code (DECL-CODE) is found in the Decline Reason Table at index WS-DECL-RSN-IDX
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The decline reason display field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with: the response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) in positions 1-4, a dash '-' in position 5, and the matched decline description (DECL-DESC at WS-DECL-RSN-IDX) starting at position 6 onwards

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Matched Decline Reason Code and Description When Found in Table
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization response reason code is found in the Decline Reason Table, the system displays the reason code followed by a dash separator and the corresponding description.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has searched the Decline Reason Table for the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No matching decline reason code is found in the Decline Reason Table (AT END condition)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The decline reason display field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with: '9999' in positions 1-4, a dash '-' in position 5, and 'ERROR' starting at position 6 onwards, resulting in the display value '9999-ERROR'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Default Error Code 9999-ERROR When Decline Reason Not Found in Table
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization response reason code cannot be found in the Decline Reason Table, the system displays a default error indicator '9999-ERROR' to signal an unrecognized decline reason.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail fields after determining the decline reason
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields are displayed on screen: Processing Code (PA-PROCESSING-CODE) in AUTHCDO, POS Entry Mode (PA-POS-ENTRY-MODE) in POSEMDO, Message Source (PA-MESSAGE-SOURCE) in AUTHSRCO, and Merchant Category Code (PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE) in MCCCDO

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Processing Code, POS Entry Mode, Message Source, and Merchant Category Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization transaction processing code, point-of-sale entry mode, message source, and merchant category code are displayed on the Authorization Detail screen to provide full transaction context.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the card expiry date (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE) where positions 1-2 are the month (MM) and positions 3-4 are the year (YY)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card expiry display field (CRDEXPO) is populated with: the month (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE positions 1-2) in positions 1-2, a slash '/' in position 3, and the year (PA-CARD-EXPIRY-DATE positions 3-4) in positions 4-5, resulting in MM/YY format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Display Card Expiry Date with Slash Separator as MM/YY
all_rules.Rule_Description: The card expiry date stored in the system in MMYY format must be formatted with a slash separator and displayed as MM/YY on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the authorization detail fields after displaying the card expiry date
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields are displayed on screen: Authorization Type (PA-AUTH-TYPE) in AUTHTYPO, Transaction ID (PA-TRANSACTION-ID) in TRNIDO, and Match Status (PA-MATCH-STATUS) in AUTHMTCO

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Authorization Type, Transaction ID, and Match Status
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization type, unique transaction identifier, and authorization match status are displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization fraud status is either PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED (fraud has been confirmed) OR PA-FRAUD-REMOVED (fraud flag was previously set and then removed)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud status display field (AUTHFRDO) is populated with: the fraud flag indicator (PA-AUTH-FRAUD) in position 1, a dash '-' in position 2, and the fraud report date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE) starting at position 3 onwards

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Fraud Flag and Fraud Report Date When Authorization Has Fraud History
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization has been either confirmed as fraudulent or had its fraud flag removed (indicating a fraud history exists), the fraud indicator and the date the fraud was reported are displayed on screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization fraud status is neither PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED nor PA-FRAUD-REMOVED (no fraud history exists for this authorization)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud status display field (AUTHFRDO) is set to a single dash '-' indicating no fraud activity associated with this authorization

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Dash for Fraud Status When Authorization Has No Fraud History
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization has no fraud history (neither confirmed as fraud nor had fraud removed), the fraud status field displays only a dash to indicate no fraud activity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail screen population process is triggered and no error flag is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the final set of authorization detail fields after displaying the fraud status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following merchant fields are displayed on screen: Merchant Name (PA-MERCHANT-NAME) in MERNAMEO, Merchant ID (PA-MERCHANT-ID) in MERIDO, Merchant City (PA-MERCHANT-CITY) in MERCITYO, Merchant State (PA-MERCHANT-STATE) in MERSTO, and Merchant ZIP Code (PA-MERCHANT-ZIP) in MERZIPO

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Complete Merchant Information on Authorization Detail Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The complete merchant information including name, identifier, city, state, and ZIP code from the pending authorization record is displayed on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been retrieved and the Authorization Response Code field (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) is available for evaluation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Authorization Response Code equals '00'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Status Indicator (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'A' representing Approved, and the display color attribute (AUTHRSPC) is set to GREEN so the status is visually highlighted in green on the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Identify Approved Authorization by Response Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization response code of '00' is received, the system identifies the transaction as approved and sets the display indicator to 'A' with a green color highlight to visually distinguish approved authorizations on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been retrieved and the Authorization Response Code field (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) is available for evaluation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Authorization Response Code is any value other than '00'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Status Indicator (AUTHRSPO) is set to 'D' representing Declined, and the display color attribute (AUTHRSPC) is set to RED so the status is visually highlighted in red on the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Identify Declined Authorization by Response Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization response code other than '00' is received, the system identifies the transaction as declined and sets the display indicator to 'D' with a red color highlight to visually distinguish declined authorizations on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Response Code has been evaluated and the Authorization Status Indicator (AUTHRSPO) has been set to either 'A' (Approved) or 'D' (Declined), and the corresponding color attribute (AUTHRSPC) has been set to either GREEN or RED
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Authorization Detail screen (COPAU1A in mapset COPAU01) is sent to the user via the SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Status Indicator field (AUTHRSPO) displays 'A' in GREEN for approved authorizations or 'D' in RED for declined authorizations, providing clear color-coded visual feedback on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Authorization Approval Status with Color Coding on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization approval or decline status indicator along with its corresponding color coding (green for approved, red for declined) is rendered on the Authorization Detail screen to provide immediate visual feedback to the user about the outcome of the authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and the Authorization Detail screen is being populated, and the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) is available from the authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system searches the Decline Reason Table (WS-DECLINE-REASON-TAB) using the authorization response reason code as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system either finds a matching decline reason entry and displays the code and description, or finds no match and displays a default error indicator in the Decline Reason field (AUTHRSNO) on the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Search Decline Reason Table for Authorization Response Reason Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: When displaying authorization details, the system searches a predefined Decline Reason Table using the authorization response reason code to retrieve the corresponding decline description for display on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is searching the Decline Reason Table and the authorization response reason code from the authorization record (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) matches a decline code entry (DECL-CODE) in the Decline Reason Table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A matching decline reason code is found in the Decline Reason Table
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Detail screen Decline Reason field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with: the authorization response reason code (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) in positions 1-4, a dash '-' separator in position 5, and the matching decline description (DECL-DESC) starting from position 6 onwards — resulting in a display format such as '0051-INSUFFICIENT FUNDS'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Matched Decline Reason Code and Description
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a matching entry is found in the Decline Reason Table for the authorization response reason code, the system formats and displays the reason code followed by a dash separator and its corresponding description on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is searching the Decline Reason Table and the authorization response reason code from the authorization record (PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON) does not match any decline code entry (DECL-CODE) in the entire Decline Reason Table
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The search reaches the end of the Decline Reason Table without finding a matching entry
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Detail screen Decline Reason field (AUTHRSNO) is populated with: the literal value '9999' in positions 1-4, a dash '-' separator in position 5, and the literal text 'ERROR' starting from position 6 onwards — resulting in a display of '9999-ERROR' to indicate an unrecognized decline reason code

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Default Error Indicator When Decline Reason Code Not Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the authorization response reason code does not match any entry in the Decline Reason Table, the system displays a default error indicator '9999-ERROR' in the Decline Reason field to signal that the reason code is unrecognized.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record has been retrieved and is being prepared for display on the Authorization Detail screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the fraud status of the authorization record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the authorization is marked as 'Fraud Confirmed' OR marked as 'Fraud Removed', the system proceeds to display the full fraud activity details (fraud flag, separator, and fraud report date); otherwise, the system proceeds to display a dash indicating no fraud activity

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Fraud Activity Status for Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether an authorization record has any fraud activity history — either currently confirmed as fraud or previously flagged and subsequently removed — to decide which fraud status display format to apply on the Authorization Detail screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record is being prepared for display on the Authorization Detail screen, AND the authorization is either currently confirmed as fraud OR has previously had its fraud flag removed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the fraud status field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud status field displays: (1) the fraud flag indicator character from the authorization record in the first position, followed by (2) a dash '-' separator in the second position, followed by (3) the fraud report date from the authorization record starting at the third position — for example: 'Y-20240115'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Full Fraud Activity Details When Fraud Is Present
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization has been confirmed as fraud or has had a fraud flag removed, the system displays the complete fraud activity information: the fraud flag indicator from the authorization record, a dash as a separator, and the date on which the fraud was reported.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization record is being prepared for display on the Authorization Detail screen, AND the authorization is NOT confirmed as fraud AND has NOT had a fraud flag removed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the fraud status field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fraud status field displays only a single dash '-' indicating that there is no fraud activity associated with this authorization

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Dash When No Fraud Activity Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization has no fraud history — meaning it has never been confirmed as fraud and has never had a fraud flag removed — the system displays only a dash in the fraud status field to indicate the absence of any fraud activity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is viewing the Authorization Detail screen with a specific authorization record displayed, identified by the current Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and the selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF5 function key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system initiates the fraud toggle process (MARK-AUTH-FRAUD) using the current Account ID and selected Authorization Key, then refreshes and sends the Authorization Detail screen with updated information

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Fraud Toggle Action on PF5 Key Press
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF5 on the Authorization Detail screen, the system initiates the fraud mark/unmark process for the currently displayed authorization record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF5 to toggle fraud status, and the session contains a valid Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID) and a selected Authorization Key (CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The fraud toggle process begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads the current authorization record from the Pending Authorization database using the Account ID and Authorization Key, loading the full authorization details including the current fraud status into the working area (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) before any fraud status evaluation occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Authorization Record Prior to Fraud Action
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before any fraud status change can be made, the system must retrieve the current authorization record from the database using the Account ID and Authorization Key to ensure the latest fraud status is evaluated.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization record has been retrieved from the database and its current fraud status is 'Confirmed Fraud' (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The fraud toggle process evaluates the current fraud status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization fraud status to 'Fraud Removed' (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED = TRUE) and sets the action indicator to 'Remove Fraud' (WS-REMOVE-FRAUD = TRUE), preparing the record for the fraud removal update

all_rules.Rule_Name: Fraud Confirmation Toggle - Remove Fraud When Already Confirmed
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the authorization record is currently marked as confirmed fraud, pressing PF5 reverses the fraud status by removing the fraud confirmation flag, effectively un-flagging the transaction as fraudulent.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization record has been retrieved from the database and its current fraud status is NOT 'Confirmed Fraud' (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is FALSE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The fraud toggle process evaluates the current fraud status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the authorization fraud status to 'Fraud Confirmed' (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED = TRUE) and sets the action indicator to 'Report Fraud' (WS-REPORT-FRAUD = TRUE), preparing the record for the fraud confirmation update

all_rules.Rule_Name: Fraud Confirmation Toggle - Mark as Fraud When Not Currently Flagged
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the authorization record is not currently marked as fraud, pressing PF5 confirms the authorization as fraudulent by setting the fraud confirmation flag.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The fraud status toggle has been determined (either FRAUD CONFIRMED or FRAUD REMOVED), the updated authorization detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) has been copied to the fraud data workspace (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD), and both the Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID → WS-FRD-ACCT-ID) and Customer ID (CDEMO-CUST-ID → WS-FRD-CUST-ID) have been populated in the fraud data communication area (WS-FRAUD-DATA)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system calls the external Fraud Processing Program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) via CICS LINK passing the fraud data communication area (WS-FRAUD-DATA)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The external Fraud Processing Program is invoked with the complete fraud data package containing the authorization details, Account ID, and Customer ID; the system then evaluates the response to determine whether to proceed with the database update or rollback

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invoke External Fraud Processing Program with Authorization and Customer Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: After determining the new fraud status, the system must call the external Fraud Processing Program (COPAUS2C) passing the full authorization details along with the Account ID and Customer ID to process the fraud action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) has been called with the fraud data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CICS LINK call to the Fraud Processing Program returns a non-normal response (EIBRESP is not equal to DFHRESP(NORMAL)), OR the fraud program returns a non-successful update indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is FALSE) along with an error message (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system performs a full rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) of all pending changes; if the fraud program returned an error message (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG), that message is displayed to the user on the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Fraud Program Failure - Rollback All Changes
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the external Fraud Processing Program returns a non-successful response (system-level failure), all pending changes must be rolled back to preserve data integrity, and the error message returned by the fraud program is displayed to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external Fraud Processing Program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD) has returned a normal CICS response (EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)) and has indicated a successful update (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system proceeds to update the authorization record in the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The updated fraud data record (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD) is written back to the Pending Authorization Details segment (PAUTDTL1) in the database using a replace operation, overwriting the previous authorization detail record with the new fraud status information

all_rules.Rule_Name: Persist Fraud Status Update to Database After Successful Fraud Program Response
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the external Fraud Processing Program confirms a successful fraud action, the system saves the updated authorization record with the new fraud status back to the Pending Authorization database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The database update of the authorization record has completed successfully (database status is OK) and the fraud action was to remove the fraud flag (PA-FRAUD-REMOVED is TRUE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the database update
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system commits all changes via a CICS SYNCPOINT and displays the confirmation message 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' to the user on the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirm Fraud Removal - Commit and Display Confirmation Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the database update succeeds and the action was to remove a fraud flag, the system commits the transaction and notifies the user that the fraud marking has been successfully removed from the authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The database update of the authorization record has completed successfully (database status is OK) and the fraud action was to confirm fraud (PA-FRAUD-CONFIRMED is TRUE, meaning PA-FRAUD-REMOVED is FALSE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the outcome of the database update
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system commits all changes via a CICS SYNCPOINT and displays the confirmation message 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' to the user on the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirm Fraud Marking - Commit and Display Confirmation Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the database update succeeds and the action was to confirm an authorization as fraud, the system commits the transaction and notifies the user that the authorization has been successfully flagged as fraudulent.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to update the authorization record in the Pending Authorization Details database segment (PAUTDTL1) with the new fraud status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database update operation returns any status other than successful (database status is not OK)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system performs a full rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) of all pending changes, sets the error flag (WS-ERR-FLG = 'Y'), and displays a system error message indicating 'System error while FRAUD Tagging, ROLLBACK' along with the database error code on the Authorization Detail screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Database Update Failure - Rollback and Display System Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the database update of the fraud status fails for any reason, the system must rollback all changes to maintain data integrity and display a system error message to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fraud toggle action (mark or unmark) has been initiated for a pending authorization, and the current authorization details (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS), Account ID (CDEMO-ACCT-ID), and Customer ID (CDEMO-CUST-ID) are available in the session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the fraud data package prior to calling the external fraud processing program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system copies the full current authorization details into the fraud data record (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD), sets the Account ID field (WS-FRD-ACCT-ID) to the session Account ID, and sets the Customer ID field (WS-FRD-CUST-ID) to the session Customer ID, forming a complete fraud data package (WS-FRAUD-DATA) ready for submission

all_rules.Rule_Name: Assemble Fraud Data Package with Authorization and Account Details
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before delegating fraud processing to the external fraud program, the system must assemble a complete fraud data package containing the full authorization details, the associated Account ID, and the Customer ID. All three components are mandatory for the fraud program to process the request.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The fraud data package (WS-FRAUD-DATA) has been fully assembled with authorization details, Account ID, and Customer ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system invokes the external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) by passing the complete fraud data package as the communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system calls the fraud processing program (WS-PGM-AUTH-FRAUD / COPAUS2C) via a synchronous program link, passing the fraud data package (WS-FRAUD-DATA), and waits for the program to complete before evaluating the response

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delegate Fraud Status Update to External Fraud Processing Program
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must delegate the actual fraud status update operation to the dedicated external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C), passing the fully assembled fraud data package. This ensures fraud processing logic is centralized in a dedicated program.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has been called with the fraud data package
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the response status from the fraud processing program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the fraud program returned a normal response, the system proceeds to evaluate whether the fraud data update itself was successful; if the fraud program returned an abnormal (non-normal) response, the system treats this as a system-level failure and proceeds to fraud update failure handling with a rollback

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Fraud Program Response to Determine Processing Path
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the external fraud processing program completes, the system must evaluate whether the program responded with a normal (successful) completion status. An abnormal response indicates a system-level failure and must be handled differently from a business-level update failure.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has responded with a normal completion status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks the fraud update success indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS) returned by the fraud program within the fraud data package
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the fraud update success indicator is set to true (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS), the system proceeds to update the authorization record in the database and display a success message; if the fraud update success indicator is not set, the system proceeds to fraud update failure handling

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Fraud Data Update Outcome After Successful Program Response
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the external fraud program responds normally, the system must further evaluate whether the fraud data update operation within that program was actually completed successfully. A normal program response does not guarantee the business update succeeded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has responded normally and the fraud update success indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS) is set to true
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that fraud processing completed successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds to execute the authorization record update process (UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS), which writes the updated fraud status back to the authorization database and displays either 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...' or 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' depending on the fraud action taken

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Authorization Record Update on Successful Fraud Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When both the fraud program response is normal and the fraud update is confirmed as successful, the system must proceed to update the authorization record in the database to reflect the new fraud status and display an appropriate confirmation message to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has responded with a normal completion status, but the fraud update success indicator (WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS) is not set, indicating a business-level update failure
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the fraud update failure condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the action message returned by the fraud program (WS-FRD-ACT-MSG) and sets it as the screen message (WS-MESSAGE) to be displayed to the user, then executes a rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) to reverse all pending database changes, ensuring no partial fraud updates are committed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Fraud Program Error Message and Rollback on Update Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the external fraud program responds normally but reports that the fraud data update was unsuccessful, the system must capture the error message provided by the fraud program, display it to the user, and rollback all pending changes to maintain data integrity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external fraud processing program (COPAUS2C) has been called with the fraud data package
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The fraud program returns an abnormal (non-normal) response status, indicating a system-level failure during fraud processing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system executes a rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) to reverse all pending database changes made during the current fraud toggle operation, ensuring the authorization record remains in its original state prior to the fraud action attempt

all_rules.Rule_Name: Rollback All Changes on Abnormal Fraud Program Response
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the external fraud processing program fails to respond normally (system-level failure), the system must immediately rollback all pending changes to ensure data integrity, as the outcome of the fraud processing is unknown.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The external fraud program has returned a successful update response, and the updated fraud authorization record (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD) contains the latest fraud status and fraud report date
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to persist the fraud status change to the Authorization Detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The updated fraud authorization record (WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD) is applied to the Pending Authorization Detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS), overwriting the previous authorization detail data with the new fraud-tagged version before the database save is attempted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Updated Fraud Record to Authorization Detail Before Saving
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the external fraud program confirms a successful fraud status update, the system must apply the updated fraud record data to the Authorization Detail record in preparation for saving to the database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Pending Authorization Detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) has been updated with the new fraud status information from the fraud program
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to save the updated Authorization Detail record to the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system replaces the existing Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1) in the database with the updated Pending Authorization Detail record, and the database operation result status is captured for success or failure evaluation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Updated Authorization Detail Record to Database
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the updated fraud record has been applied to the Authorization Detail, the system must persist the updated Authorization Detail record to the database by replacing the existing record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Detail record has been successfully saved to the database with the updated fraud status (database update status is OK)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system confirms the database update was successful
